articles.title: Sony pone a la venta una versión más barata de la PlayStation 5, pero no todos la podrán comprar
articles.text:
Sony presentó una nueva edición de la PlayStation 5 con un precio considerablemente menor al estándar, aunque su venta quedará restringida a Japón. Se trata de la PS5 Digital Edition en color Midnight Black, que saldrá a la venta el 19 de noviembre, la misma fecha en que debuta Grand Theft Auto VI, el título de Rockstar Games más esperado del año.
La consola se comercializará en Japón por 55.000 yenes, equivalentes a unos 380 dólares según la conversión directa, aunque medios especializados también situaron la cifra cercana a los 347 dólares.
El monto representa una diferencia notable frente a los 599 dólares que cuesta actualmente la PS5 Digital Edition estándar en otros mercados, precio que Sony ajustó al alza en marzo de este año. El lanzamiento coincide con un período de aumento generalizado en el costo de las consolas, atribuido a la crisis de memoria, la escasez de componentes, los aranceles comerciales y la inflación. Las proyecciones del sector anticipan nuevas subas para 2027.
Las restricciones que limitan su alcance
El PS5 Midnight Black se basa en una variante exclusiva que Sony ya comercializaba en Japón, por lo que conserva un bloqueo regional: solo admite configuración de idioma japonés y requiere una cuenta de PlayStation Network registrada en esa región. Estas limitaciones impiden que la consola funcione con normalidad fuera del país, lo que reduce de forma significativa la posibilidad de importarla pese a su atractivo precio.
En términos de hardware, el nuevo modelo no incorpora mejoras de rendimiento ni cambios técnicos respecto a la PS5 Digital Edition convencional: mantiene el mismo SSD de 825 gigabytes. Su principal diferencial es estético, ya que ofrece un acabado completamente negro acompañado de un mando DualSense del mismo tono.
Una fecha que coincide con el lanzamiento de GTA VI
El anuncio llega en un contexto de fuerte demanda de consolas, impulsada por la expectativa en torno a GTA VI, lo que según reportes generó escasez de unidades de PS5 en algunas regiones. La coincidencia entre el lanzamiento de la consola económica y el estreno del videojuego no fue explicada oficialmente por la compañía, aunque la fecha compartida resulta un dato relevante para quienes buscan adquirir un sistema antes del debut del título.
Junto a la consola, Sony también pondrá a la venta una unidad de disco a juego en el mismo color Midnight Black, con un costo de 11.980 yenes, unos 76 dólares. Este accesorio permitirá reproducir juegos físicos en una consola que, de otro modo, solo admite formato digital.
El plan de Sony para dejar atrás los juegos físicos
El comunicado difundido en el PlayStation Blog japonés reiteró además los planes de la compañía de reducir de forma gradual la distribución física de videojuegos. Según el texto, los nuevos títulos de PlayStation lanzados a partir de enero de 2028 estarán disponibles únicamente como descargas digitales a través de PlayStation Store y distribuidores autorizados. Los juegos físicos publicados antes de esa fecha seguirán siendo compatibles con las consolas.
La medida, sumada al lanzamiento regional del nuevo modelo, generó debate entre los usuarios. En un hilo publicado en Reddit, varios comentarios destacaron el diseño del nuevo color y expresaron expectativas sobre futuras cubiertas a juego para la PS5 Pro.
Otros usuarios discutieron las diferencias de precio entre regiones, al señalar factores como la debilidad del yen y el menor poder adquisitivo en Japón, mientras que algunos cuestionaron que la conversión directa a dólares no refleje el contexto económico local. La ausencia de una unidad de disco integrada en el modelo digital también fue motivo de discusión, en particular entre quienes prefieren conservar consolas con soporte físico.

articles.title: Chainguard puts Claude Mythos on flaw hunting, secures coding agents and widens Libraries - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Chainguard puts Claude Mythos on flaw hunting, secures coding agents and widens Libraries
Secure software supply chain solution provider Chainguard Inc. today unveiled a vulnerability-hunting service that uses frontier artificial intelligence models such as Anthropic PBC’s Claude Mythos 5.1, as well as two products for securing AI coding agents and an expansion of Chainguard Libraries.
All four arrived at the company’s Assemble London conference today.
Vulnerability hunting falls to Chainguard Harness, which reports only the flaws it can reproduce against a live build of a customer’s application. Developers and their agents get a hardened, credential-free cloud environment from Chainguard Workspaces.
Because that work still has to be tested, Chainguard paired Workspaces with Chainguard Checks, which runs continuous integration tests on the code before anyone opens a pull request. Go and .NET developers are the new audience for Chainguard Libraries, the company’s service for vetted open-source dependencies.
Harness is aimed at organizations that want frontier-model vulnerability hunting without direct access to the models themselves. According to Chainguard, those models have mostly gone to a small set of groups doing defensive security work, and static scanners miss the logic flaws that only surface once an application is running.
Customers connect a repository through Chainguard’s Guardener GitHub app. From there, Harness compiles the application as it would ship, and the build boots in an isolated virtual machine cut off from the outside network. A frontier model then probes that running copy the way an attacker would. Nothing gets reported until it reproduces in a fresh environment on every replay, according to the company. A Chainguard engineer signs off on every report and fix before a customer sees it.
“Every time we’ve pointed Harness at code, it has found serious, exploitable vulnerabilities, including in software that’s been scanned many times over and code that runs critical infrastructure,” said co-founder and Chief Executive Dan Lorenc.
For now, Chainguard’s own staff run Harness for customers. Scans of the open-source artifacts the company distributes end in patched builds shipped through Chainguard Repository.
When Harness runs against a customer’s own code, the customer receives a write-up covering severity, reproduction steps and a recommended fix. Flaws turned up in open-source projects go to upstream maintainers through Athena, a disclosure coalition Chainguard set up in June.
Anthropic is also selling Harness. The service is listed on the Claude Marketplace, which opened in March, and enterprises can put part of an existing Anthropic spending commitment toward it. Daniela Hurtado, head of commercial cyber at Anthropic, said how a model like Mythos 5.1 gets deployed “matters as much as the capability itself.”
Harness looks for flaws in software a company already ships. The two agent products step in earlier, at the point where coding agents are still writing the code. Chainguard Workspaces and Chainguard Checks are built for teams whose agents run long migrations with the same permissions as the developer who launched them, within reach of cloud keys and production systems. Approval prompts depend on the agent following the rules, and a developer juggling a dozen agents can end up clicking “allow” all day.
Each workspace is a remote virtual machine built entirely from Chainguard OS packages. Syncing with the developer’s local working tree keeps the editor and git workflow on the laptop while execution happens remotely.
Real credentials stay outside the machine. Tools that need one on disk get an encrypted, short-lived stand-in, and teams can switch on egress policies that block any connection they have not approved. Lorenc described the result as an isolated machine “with nothing in it worth stealing.”
Checks takes aim at the queue that forms when agents push code far more often than continuous integration systems were designed for. Each run starts from a warm snapshot with dependencies already installed. An agent working in a workspace has its session suspended during testing, then picks up again with any failure logs fed straight into its context.
Passing runs produce a signed attestation tied to the environment, test result and commit. Merge gates can verify that attestation and merge the code without running the suite again.
James Governor, co-founder of analyst firm RedMonk LLC, said existing continuous integration platforms are “struggling under the massive increase in load” that agentic development has brought. Australian payments infrastructure provider Cuscal Ltd. is an early design partner on both products.
The Libraries update takes the service to five languages. Java was the only language Libraries supported when Chainguard introduced the service in March 2025, and Python and JavaScript have joined it since. Teams building on .NET can now swap NuGet for a Chainguard-managed endpoint.
Go and .NET both come with configurable blocking policies and malware scanning that also catches greyware. Chainguard applies the term to packages that work as advertised while also doing something malicious, such as harvesting credentials.
Chainguard is pitching the Go libraries at teams that build cloud and infrastructure software in the language. Older Go packages also get backported upstream fixes when a critical- or high-severity known vulnerability is found, sparing teams pinned to them a forced major upgrade. JavaScript libraries now carry the same remediation.
Java and Python get zero-day protection drawn from findings that Athena members pool. Chainguard says patched artifacts for flaws found by frontier AI models will be ready the day each one is made public.
Workspaces and Checks are available in beta test starting today. Harness is open through a waitlist for its own beta, and early access has started for the Go and .NET libraries.
Chainguard is a venture capital-backed startup that has raised about $892 million since its founding in 2021. The latest $280 million came from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund last October.

articles.title: VisionQuest star James Spader says Marvel fans will see an 'older and more mature' Ultron in the new Disney+ show — but the 'inherent threat' he poses is also still there
articles.text:
VisionQuest star James Spader says playing Ultron in the new Marvel TV show was 'even more interesting' than what he had to do in Avengers: Age of Ultron — and I can see why
- James Spader has teased what fans can expect from Ultron in VisionQuest
- It'll reunite us with the genocidal android 12 years after his last MCU appearance
- The Marvel TV show allows Spader to further explore the fan-favorite villain
VisionQuest actor James Spader has opened up on the "older and more mature" Ultron we'll see in the new Marvel TV show — and the "inherent danger" he still poses.
Speaking exclusively to TechRadar at the series' UK junket, Spader teased how Ultron has evolved since his sole appearance in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU), which came in 2014's Avengers: Age of Ultron.
Back then, fans believed they'd seen the last of the genocidal android because — spoilers for a 12-year-old movie incoming — Ultron was destroyed. However, over a decade on from his apparent demise at Vision's hands, Ultron has returned, with a back-up copy of his source code retained by Vision in his mind — or, rather, his quantum processor.
In the years that have followed, Ultron has been able to observe humanity and events in the MCU through Vision's eyes.
And, with Vision turning inward as he seeks answers to questions like "who am I?" and "what is my purpose?" in his self-titled Disney+ show, Ultron will be one of the many Tony Stark-created AIs that Vision will look to for guidance. So, what kind of Ultron should we expect to encounter in the final installment of Marvel's Wanda/Vision TV trilogy?
"When you play any character, you fill out that individual, even if there isn't the real estate to be able to express aspects of them that you want to," Spader told me. "But, they're still in your head, so to suddenly be able to revisit Ultron, who I played in fits and starts, and fill in those blanks in the longer-form medium of television, was even more interesting than when I first took on the role 12 years ago.
"The character has become more of itself, and Ultron has certainly evolved. He's more acute, more developed, and he's older and more mature. He can still be quite childish, but he's not quite as sophomoric as he was in Age of Ultron. His humor is more witty, and he's certainly smarter than before.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
"But, I also think the inherent danger and threat that was so blatantly there in Age of Ultron is still present," Spader added of Ultron's presence in the Marvel Phase 6 project. "All of that knowledge he consumed like junk food as a bratty teenager in Age of Ultron, a lot of that has been absorbed and processed. And, in that attic inside Vision's head, he's been given an odd amount of autonomy and freedom for someone who one must be careful with. So, you'll see all of that plays out in these eight episodes."
Ready to watch VisionQuest? Before it arrives, check out my VisionQuest review of all eight episodes (don't worry, it doesn't contain any major spoilers). Afterwards, find out when every chapter will drop on Disney+ using my VisionQuest release schedule guide.

articles.title: Corsair Enters Fast Growing Mobile Recording Market with New Elgato Wireless Microphone
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Corsair Enters Fast Growing Mobile Recording Market with New Elgato Wireless Microphone
Elgato, a Corsair brand, today introduced Wave Go, its first wireless microphone, extending its Wave audio lineup beyond the desktop to the fast growing mobile recording segment with a clip-on microphone and a handheld interview mic in one portable system. The global launch brings Elgato into a new growth category while connecting mobile creators to its existing audio software and Stream Deck controls.
Julian Fest, SVP and General Manager of Elgato"More content is being filmed on phones today than ever before, in more places and in ways that didn't exist a few years ago," "Wave Go was built for that world. One mic that handles it all, and sounds amazing the entire time."
Key Product Highlights
- Integrates with the Popular Elgato Ecosystem: Wave Link and Stream Deck integration connects mobile recording with desktop production.
- Two recording modes: Switch from a magnetic clip-on microphone to a handheld interview mic in seconds using the included Smart Handle.
- Lightweight design: The coin-sized transmitter weighs just 7 grams and attaches magnetically to clothing.
- Automatic audio processing: EQ Shift selects the sound profile for each mode. Auto Gain, a limiter, and a low-cut filter help manage voice levels and low-frequency rumble.
- Up to 48 hours of total runtime: The transmitter provides up to 8 hours per charge, and the Smart Handle stores up to five full recharges. A 10-minute charge provides about an hour of use.
- Simple phone recording: Connect through the USB-C receiver, with pass-through phone charging and on-device controls for recording, mute, and noise cancellation.
- Complete system for $99.99: Includes the transmitter, receiver, Smart Handle, carrying case, magnetic mounts, windscreens, and charging cable. A second transmitter costs $29.99 USD, or $14.99 USD when purchased with Wave Go on elgato.com.
- Broad launch reach: Direct availability in more than 40 countries and regions, with Corsair's authorized retail network to follow.
One Microphone for Mobile Recording and Interviews
Wave Go connects to a phone through a single USB-C receiver and switches between clip-on and handheld recording in seconds. The coin-sized transmitter weighs about 0.25 ounces and attaches magnetically to clothing. Its clip-on sound profile restores vocal clarity and presence when recording at chest level. For interviews, the transmitter slots into the Smart Handle to become a full-sized handheld microphone. The handle adds recording controls and charging, while a dedicated sound profile adjusts the microphone for the warmth and presence of close-up speech.
Automatic Audio Processing and Simple Controls
Wave Go combines a condenser capsule with onboard processing to deliver detailed voice recording without manual setup. EQ Shift automatically selects the sound profile for clip-on or handheld use. Auto Gain adjusts levels as voices get louder or quieter, while a limiter controls sudden peaks and a low-cut filter reduces low-frequency rumble. These features work automatically, without navigating menus or adjusting settings. A single button on the transmitter and Smart Handle controls power, mute, and recording on a connected phone. A button on the receiver switches noise cancellation on or off to reduce background noise. LEDs on all three components show operating status and battery level.
Up to 48 Hours of Runtime with Smart Handle Recharging
The transmitter delivers up to 8 hours of recording on a single charge. The Smart Handle stores up to five full recharges and charges the transmitter while it is docked, including during recording. Combined with the transmitter's initial charge, this provides up to 48 hours of total runtime. A 10-minute charge provides about an hour of use. The carrying case holds the transmitter, Smart Handle, receiver, and an optional second microphone. When connected to USB-C power, it recharges the system's components together. The receiver supports USB-C pass-through charging to keep a connected phone powered while recording.
Sources:

articles.title: HomeView : Apple dévoile son écran connecté pour la maison, mais la France reste à la porte
articles.text:
Apple présente HomeView, un écran connecté de 7 pouces qui réunit divertissement, appels vidéo et commandes domotiques. Proposé à 299 dollars aux États-Unis, il ne sera pas commercialisé dans l’Union européenne au lancement.
Dans la maison connectée d’Apple, il manquait encore quelqu’un à l’accueil. L’iPhone donne les commandes, le HomePod tend l’oreille et l’Apple TV travaille sous le téléviseur. HomeView ajoute un écran que toute la famille pourra consulter et utiliser. Pour lui trouver une place sur le plan de travail, Apple mise sur les petits gestes du quotidien, de la recette du soir aux lumières à éteindre.
Un écran partagé, une expérience personnelle
HomeView associe une puce A18 à un écran tactile Liquid Retina de 7 pouces. Le modèle à poser repose sur une base sonore en aluminium, avec une charnière permettant d’incliner l’affichage. Une seconde version est destinée au mur. Les deux doivent rester branchées : Apple ne propose pas ici une tablette à emporter d’une pièce à l’autre.
L’interface adapte la quantité d’informations à la distance de l’utilisateur. Depuis le canapé, l’écran privilégie la lisibilité ; en s’approchant, on accède à davantage de détails. HomeView reconnaît aussi jusqu’à six personnes pour afficher leurs applications et widgets. Les messages et calendriers personnels restent soumis à la reconnaissance du visage, ainsi qu’à la présence de l’iPhone ou de l’iPad associé, récemment déverrouillé.
Dans la cuisine, l’appareil peut transformer une recette consultée sur le Web en étapes à suivre, avec des minuteurs commandés à la voix. Dans le salon, il permet d’écouter de la musique, de regarder une vidéo ou d’afficher des photos. Handoff assure la continuité de certains usages commencés sur l’iPhone, tandis qu’AirPlay permet de diffuser la musique dans plusieurs pièces.
Les appels FaceTime profitent d’une caméra de 12 mégapixels avec cadrage automatique. Quatre microphones captent les demandes à distance. L’interphone permet également d’envoyer un message aux autres appareils du foyer : de quoi appeler tout le monde à table sans traverser la maison.
Un tableau de bord domotique porté par Siri AI, et cela bloque le lancement en Europe
HomeView permet de commander les lumières, le thermostat, les serrures ou les stores compatibles, au toucher ou avec Siri. Il peut afficher jusqu’à neuf flux de caméras simultanément. Certaines fonctions de surveillance, dont les résumés vidéo, nécessitent toutefois un abonnement iCloud+ éligible et un appareil compatible Apple Intelligence.
Siri AI sert aussi à poser des questions et retrouver des informations personnelles depuis un iPhone ou iPad compatible associé. L’assistant fonctionne initialement en anglais ; le français canadien arrivera ultérieurement.
Les deux modèles sont proposés à 299 dollars aux États-Unis, avec des précommandes dès aujourd’hui et une disponibilité le 13 novembre. Le modèle à poser existe en quatre coloris, contre deux pour la version murale, dont les accessoires de fixation sont vendus séparément.
Apple ne commercialisera cependant pas HomeView dans l’Union européenne au lancement, invoquant l’indisponibilité de Siri AI sur iOS dans cette région. Aucun calendrier français n’est annoncé pour l’heure. Il faudra probablement attendre que la Commission européenne et Apple se mettent d’accord avant d’espérer le voir trôner sur notre buffet.

articles.title: 290 km d’autonomie et 2,75 mètres de long : Smart relance son modèle culte dès 19 990 €
articles.text:
« Parking King » : le panneau planté à proximité de la nouvelle Smart #2 est pour le moins suggestif. Vu la longueur riquiqui de 2,75 mètres, l’allemande peut en effet stationner dans un mouchoir de poche, à l’instar de son illustre ancêtre, la Fortwo. Mais contrairement à cette dernière, l’#2 troque le moteur à explosion pour une batterie reliée à une machine électrique. Elle demeure néanmoins une stricte propulsion comme le modèle de 1997.
Avec 82 ch et 130 Nm de couple, l’#2 filera en silence, mais aussi moins loin. Avec son pack de 35,8 kWh, l’auto revendique 290 km d’autonomie sur le cycle WLTP. Cela reste très largement suffisant pour un véhicule ultra citadin. Et en cas d’escapade éventuelle, la recharge rapide est incluse avec une puissance de 65 kW en courant continu DC. De quoi passer de 10 à 80 % de batterie en 20 minutes. Le package est convaincant dans un si petit gabarit.
Conduite semi-autonome et V2L : ce que cache la version de base à 19 990 €
En revanche, le prix n’est pas aussi contenu puisque l’entrée de gamme est affichée à 19 990 €. L’équipement est en contrepartie riche car la finition Pure embarque d’emblée l’accès et démarrage mains-libres, la recharge bidirectionnelle V2L, les feux à LED avec feux de route automatique ainsi que la conduite semi-autonome. Oui, le pilotage semi-automatique est inclus en série sur une Smart premier prix. Qui l’eût cru ?
Pour 1 000 € de plus, la Pure+ gagne la recharge 11 kW en courant alternatif AC permettant de se charger plus vite sur les bornes publiques. Le siège conducteur chauffant s’invite aussi à la fête. À 24 490 €, la version Premium passe un cap avec le toit panoramique, les sièges en similicuir et la sonorisation Sennheiser avec 7 haut-parleurs. Des combinaisons de couleurs supplémentaires comprenant des teintes bicolores renforcent aussi l’offre de personnalisation.
Jusqu’à 25 690 € : que proposent les finitions Premium et Couture Edition ?
Enfin trône en haut de gamme la Couture Edition à 25 690 €. Un fer de lance qui demeurera cependant temporaire puisque cette version sera limitée à seulement 999 exemplaires. Les quelques chanceux auront droit à une présentation spécifique avec une peinture blanche doublée d’un toit couleur or. Les jantes de 16 pouces gagnent également des détails dorés, au même titre que certains détails de carrosserie.
La calandre, fidèle à celle portée par le concept avec des parties imitant des lanières en cuir, est unique à cette version. Toit en verre, éclairage d’ambiance, sièges et volant chauffants, sonorisation Sennheiser, recharge du smartphone sans fil et navigation sont également de la partie. Les précommandes de la nouvelle Smart #2 sont d’ores et déjà ouvertes pour toutes les versions.

articles.title: “Rockstar commence toujours par la console” : finalement, GTA 6 ne ferait patienter les joueurs PC que quelques mois
articles.text:
“Rockstar commence toujours par la console” : finalement, GTA 6 ne ferait patienter les joueurs PC que quelques mois
Quatre sources de l'industrie l'affirment : la version PC de GTA 6 sortirait entre janvier et mars 2027, quelques semaines à peine après les consoles. Ce calendrier éclair tombe pile au moment où la PS5 cède sous les jailbreaks et où les émulateurs PC commencent à grignoter ses exclusivités.
Les joueurs PC s'étaient résignés à une longue traversée du désert. Ils pourraient finalement arpenter Vice City bien plus tôt que prévu. D'après le site américain GamesBeat, qui s'appuie sur quatre sources anonymes proches du studio, Rockstar prévoit de lancer Grand Theft Auto VI sur ordinateur au premier trimestre 2027. Le jeu reste attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X, S. Sollicité, l'éditeur n'a pas répondu.
GTA 6 sur PC : pourquoi Rockstar presserait le pas
L'écart tranche avec les habitudes de la maison. GTA V avait patienté dix-neuf mois avant d'atterrir sur PC en avril 2015, Red Dead Redemption 2 un peu plus d'un an. Strauss Zelnick, patron de Take-Two, reconnaissait pourtant en mai que l'ordinateur pèse désormais près de la moitié des ventes d'un gros titre. Avec un budget qui dépasserait, selon les rumeurs, deux milliards de dollars, chaque trimestre compte.
GamesBeat avance aussi la piste du jeu de rôle en ligne. Rockstar a racheté en août 2023 Cfx.re, l'équipe derrière FiveM, dont les serveurs roleplay tournent exclusivement sur PC. Or, selon Dan Clancy, patron de Twitch, interrogé par Bloomberg au Tokyo Game Show, le volet online de GTA 6 arrivera "l'an prochain".
	
Rockstar commence toujours par la console, parce qu'avec une sortie de cette ampleur, on est jugé sur la manière dont on sert son public de cœur.
Jailbreak PS5 et émulation : un calendrier qui tombe à pic
L'accélération a aussi des vertus défensives. Depuis fin septembre, l'exploit Relapse déverrouille toute PS5, Pro comprise, dont le firmware se situe entre 7.00 et 13.60. Aidés d'outils d'IA, les moddeurs y ont déjà greffé des émulateurs Switch, Xbox ou PS2. Côté PC, la cadence donne le vertige : KytyPS5 a fait tourner la version PS5 de GTA V jusqu'à 60 images par seconde le temps du prologue. Le pirate Cyberleek, lui, continue d'égrener des vidéos de GTA 6 tirées, d'après plusieurs développeurs, d'une build PC. Il menace même de publier le jeu complet.
GTA 6 échappera (vraisemblablement) à Relapse : le firmware 14.00, déployé par Sony le 16 septembre, colmate la brèche, et les dernières sorties l'exigent déjà. Mais une version PC officielle, disponible quelques semaines après les consoles, couperait l'herbe sous le pied des builds volées et des émulateurs bancals. Pour Rockstar, chaque mois gagné vaut rempart.

articles.title: WhatsApp se actualiza en iPhone: qué cambia y dónde encontrar los nuevos ajustes
articles.text:
WhatsApp prueba un nuevo diseño de ajustes en iPhone, con una estructura dividida en dos secciones para facilitar el acceso a las funciones de mayor uso. La modificación ya comenzó a aparecer entre algunos usuarios de la beta para iOS y reorganiza la pestaña de Configuración, que hasta ahora reunía todas las opciones en una sola pantalla.
La acumulación de apartados había convertido la búsqueda de un ajuste concreto en una tarea menos directa. La nueva interfaz separa las funciones frecuentes de los menús más técnicos, sin eliminar el buscador interno.
La pestaña principal pasa a llamarse Tú
La actualización beta 26.40.10.76, distribuida mediante TestFlight, incorpora la nueva organización de la pestaña de Configuración de WhatsApp. El diseño sustituye la lista única por dos pantallas conectadas entre sí.
De acuerdo con WABetaInfo, la primera recibe el nombre de “Tú” y concentra los elementos personales y las herramientas que la aplicación considera prioritarias. En la parte superior se mantiene la fotografía de perfil, junto al mensaje de estado visible para quienes consulten la cuenta.
Debajo del nombre, el usuario encontrará dos botones para editar o compartir el perfil. Más abajo aparecerán accesos directos a las funciones que WhatsApp sitúa como las más utilizadas:
- Suscripciones
- Listas
- Mensajes de difusión
- Eventos
- Destacados
- Dispositivos vinculados
La interfaz incluye una indicación en la parte inferior para recordar que existen más opciones. Estas se abrirán desde el icono de engranaje ubicado en la parte superior de la pestaña.
El engranaje abrirá los ajustes menos frecuentes
Al pulsar el icono, WhatsApp mostrará una página secundaria con el resto de los controles. Esta pantalla conservará la barra de búsqueda, una herramienta que permite localizar una opción sin recorrer manualmente todos los apartados.
El nuevo menú incluirá las secciones de Cuenta, Privacidad, Chats, Apariencia, Notificaciones, Agentes, Almacenamiento y datos, y Controles parentales. También reunirá los accesos a Ayuda, Enviar comentarios e Invitar a un amigo.
En la zona inferior estará el Centro de cuentas de Meta. Desde allí se podrán vincular los datos de WhatsApp con otros perfiles y servicios de la compañía. La ubicación de este apartado no cambia su función, pero evita que ocupe espacio dentro de la pestaña inicial.
La reorganización no elimina ajustes, sino que distribuye las opciones en dos niveles. El primer nivel se enfocará en consultas frecuentes; el segundo concentrará herramientas de seguridad, administración de datos y personalización.
WhatsApp busca reducir el desplazamiento dentro de iOS
La razón principal del rediseño está relacionada con el crecimiento de la lista de opciones. Cada nueva función añadida por WhatsApp ampliaba la página de Configuración y obligaba a desplazarse para encontrar funciones como los dispositivos vinculados o los mensajes destacados.
La división pretende reducir ese recorrido. Los apartados vinculados con el perfil y la gestión cotidiana estarán disponibles de inmediato, mientras que el resto quedará a un toque de distancia. La barra de búsqueda se mantendrá como alternativa para quienes ya conocen el nombre del ajuste que necesitan.
Este cambio forma parte de una revisión más amplia de la navegación de WhatsApp para iPhone. Durante el año, la aplicación modificó la pantalla de información de los chats grupales con un sistema de pestañas. También introdujo un menú de accesos rápidos en los chats para mostrar acciones habituales sin abrir páginas adicionales.
La nueva configuración sigue esa misma lógica: menos elementos visibles en cada pantalla y rutas más claras hacia las funciones menos utilizadas.
La prueba está limitada a usuarios de TestFlight
Por ahora, el diseño está disponible para una parte de los usuarios que instalen la beta 26.40.10.76 desde TestFlight. WhatsApp distribuye la función de forma gradual, por lo que algunos probadores todavía verán la configuración tradicional de una sola página.
La disponibilidad escalonada permite detectar errores, comprobar la respuesta de los usuarios y ajustar elementos de la interfaz antes de una publicación general. No existe una fecha anunciada para el lanzamiento estable en la App Store.
Los usuarios que reciban la actualización podrán comprobar si la pestaña de Configuración fue sustituida por “Tú”. Si el cambio no aparece, será necesario esperar a una futura activación desde los servidores de WhatsApp, incluso con la versión beta instalada.

articles.title: Pluto Security nabs $42M to help enterprises secure their AI agents - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Pluto Security nabs $42M to help enterprises secure their AI agents
Pluto Security Inc., a provider of artificial intelligence security software, today announced that it has raised $42 million in funding.
The company raised about a fifth of the sum through a seed round led by TLV Partners. The rest arrived in the form of a Series A investment led by Jump Capital. The latter deal also included contributions from several other backers including Skinos, a fund affiliated with Point Software Technologies Ltd. co-founder Shlomo Kramer.
Manually identifying every single AI agent in a corporate network is often prohibitively time-consuming. As a result, administrators can overlook agents that pose cybersecurity risks. Tel Aviv-based Pluto offers a platform designed to address that challenge. It can automatically map out agents across employee endpoints, cloud infrastructure and software-as-a-service applications.
The platform collects detailed telemetry about each agent that it detects. Pluto identifies the AI model that powers an agent, the tool it uses to carry out its work and whether users have added any customizations. Those customizations often take the form of plugins, file repositories that contain prompts and integrations with external applications.
According to TechCrunch, Pluto collects agent telemetry using customers’ other cybersecurity tools. It also deploys lightweight data collection programs called sensors. Pluto’s sensors rely on hardware-efficient AI models to identify malicious activity. When an agent attempts to perform a risky action, Pluto sends it a prompt that instructs it to stop the workflow.
Companies can customize how Pluto mitigates risks by defining cybersecurity policies. A software startup, for example, can create a policy that only allows developers to run AI-generated scripts if they don’t interact with a sensitive system. It’s also possible to regulate AI agents’ tools and user-created customizations.
The company offers its cybersecurity platform alongside a free service called Plutonium. It enables companies to check publicly available agent extensions, application connectors and MCP servers for risks before installing them. Plutonium provides data about more than 4,500 such tools.
Pluto’s third focus area is cybersecurity research. Earlier this month, the company’s researchers uncovered a hacking campaign that targeted users of Solidity, a programming language optimized for smart contract projects. A smart contract is a transaction processing script that runs on a blockchain.
Pluto reportedly generates more than $2 million in annualized revenue from over 30 enterprise customers. Its free Plutonium service has several thousand users. The company will use its new funding to grow its workforce, enhance its commercial offering and finance more cybersecurity research.

articles.title: Global 300mm Fab Equipment Spending to Reach $227 Billion in 2029 as Buildout Accelerates
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Global 300mm Fab Equipment Spending to Reach $227 Billion in 2029 as Buildout Accelerates
Global 300 mm front-end fab equipment spending is projected to reach $149 billion in 2026, up 31% year-over-year, SEMI reported today in its latest 300 mm Fab Outlook. Investment is expected to continue growing at double-digit rates through 2029, reaching $227 billion. The stronger investment trajectory is accompanied by a sustained pipeline of new 300 mm fabs and production lines moving through construction and into operation. Excluding pure R&D fabs, SEMI projects 20 new 300 mm fabs or lines to begin construction worldwide in 2026 and 18 in 2027. In the United States, three are projected to begin construction in 2026 and four in 2027.
Ajit Manocha, SEMI President and CEO"Semiconductor demand is increasingly translating into physical manufacturing expansion across the global industry," "The latest outlook points to both stronger equipment investment and a substantial pipeline of fabs moving toward operation. This expansion will provide the manufacturing foundation needed to support AI, high-performance computing and a broad range of next-generation semiconductor applications."
Global Fab Construction Pipeline
Across all 300 mm facilities, global fab construction spending is projected to rise 23% to $47.5 billion in 2026 and another 33% to $63.3 billion in 2027, before reaching $68.4 billion in 2028. The construction activity reflects continued investment in new manufacturing capacity across leading-edge logic, memory and other 300 mm semiconductor technologies.
The U.S. represents an important part of this expansion, with additional 300 mm fabs and lines expected to begin construction throughout the forecast period. Equipment investment in the Americas is projected to more than double from $18.1 billion in 2026 to $40.6 billion in 2029, reflecting the region's expanding manufacturing footprint.
SEMI projects 13 new 300 mm fabs or lines worldwide to begin operations or ship first silicon in 2026, increasing to 23 in 2027.
The 3Q26 edition of the SEMI 300 mm Fab Outlook reflects 166 changes across 163 fabs and lines, including 14 newly added records, since the previous report.

articles.title: Most U.S. drone shipments went to Ukraine while Iran’s went to Russia
articles.text:
The US exported the most drones over the past few years — but the second-biggest exporter might surprise you
US and Iran account for 86% of global military drone exports
- The US exported 7,592 military drones, narrowly ahead of Iran's 6,800
- Iran overtook America in 2025 after US deliveries dropped to 402
- Russia received 99% of Iran's exported drones, mostly Shahed-136 attack systems
The United States exported the most military drones between 2022 and 2025, narrowly beating Iran, which ranked second worldwide during the period.
Data from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) records 7,592 American exports against 6,800 Iranian deliveries, while Germany ranked a distant third with 1,000 exports.
Together, the US and Iran accounted for 86% of global exports, with Ukraine receiving 95% of American shipments while Russia got 99% of Iran’s deliveries, most of which were Shahed-136 one-way attack drones.
Iran overtakes the US as exports shift
Although Washington maintained the lead across most of the period, annual figures changed significantly in 2025, when Iranian deliveries exceeded American shipments.
Iran exported 2,002 drones that year, compared with 402 delivered by the United States.
The decline of American shipments is due to the suspension of military assistance to Ukraine, which had received most US exports during the preceding years.
Subsequent American deliveries were directed mainly toward Taiwan, marking a change in the destinations receiving these systems.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
The figures cover military drones weighing at least 150 kilograms, equivalent to approximately 331 pounds, including loitering munitions and one-way attack aircraft.
Small first-person-view drones and commercial models were excluded, meaning the figures do not capture every type of unmanned aircraft supplied internationally.
One-way attack platforms accounted for 97% of recorded exports, indicating that expendable systems dominated the shipments measured by SIPRI during the period.
Their prevalence also explains why the figures should not be interpreted as a comprehensive count of military drones worldwide.
Poland and others trail the leading exporters
In addition to the top exporters, within the same period, Poland exported 690 drones to take fourth place while Turkey occupied fifth place with 381 exports, despite supplying customers across a considerably wider international network.
Ankara delivered drones to 28 countries, including Pakistan, Kuwait and Romania, which belong to the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).
Its Bayraktar TB2 accounted for 58% of worldwide exports of reusable drones, distinguishing Turkey’s position within that category.
The Czech Republic, Sweden and the next seven countries in the rankings collectively exported just 89 drones, considerably fewer than Germany or Poland.
Their combined deliveries also fell far below Turkey’s total, despite the latter ranking behind both European countries in overall export numbers.
The figures therefore distinguish the country’s leading total military drone shipments from those supplying particular categories of aircraft.
However, SIPRI’s weight threshold and exclusion of smaller commercial and first-person-view models limit comparisons with estimates covering the entire unmanned aircraft market.

articles.title: ColorOS 17 arrive dès la semaine prochaine : le calendrier complet du déploiement dévoilé
articles.text:
ColorOS arrive dès la semaine prochaine, pour accompagner de nouveaux téléphone portables du fabricant chinois. Quels modèles seront les premiers servis ? Quelles sont les réelles modifications ?
Initialement lancée en Chine avec la série Find X10 Pro Max, la nouvelle mouture de l'interface d'Oppo, ColorOS 17, sera prochainement disponible sur de nombreux smartphones. Le lancement officiel est programmé pour le mercredi 21 octobre, date à laquelle les smartphones Find X10 et Find X10 Pro Max seront commercialisés avec cette version préinstallée.
Un calendrier de mise à jour étalé jusqu'en 2027
À la suite de ce lancement, la mise à jour sera progressivement déployée sur les appareils plus anciens. Les premiers modèles concernés seront servis à la fin du mois d'octobre :
- 29 octobre : Oppo Find N6, Find X9 Ultra, Find X9s, Find X9 Pro et Find X9
- 30 octobre : Oppo Find N5, Find X8 Pro, Find X8, ainsi que l'ensemble de la gamme Reno 16 (Reno 16 Pro, Reno 16, Reno 16c, Reno 16 F et Reno 16 FS)
Les séries Reno 14 et 15 verront ColorOS 17 débarquer sur courant novembre, les modèles F et K de la marque profiteront de cette nouvelle version ultérieurement. Certaines tablettes devraient également avoir droit à ColorOS 17, mais plutôt courant 2027.
Quels changements apporte ColorOS 17 ?
D'un point de vue purement esthétique, ColorOS succède aux versions précédentes qui avaient vu arriver de nouvelles animations. Cette nouvelle version intègre le "Living Flow Design", qui ajuste le rendu translucide façon Liquid Glass d'Apple, mais ajoute aussi des animations réactives lors des interactions tactiles sur divers éléments de l'écran.
- Zoom optique 10x
- Qualité photo globale ; rendu Hasselblad
- AI Mind Space
- Performances générales
- Quantié photo & vidéo
- Excellente autonomie
Sur le plan interne, le système s'appuie sur une nouvelle architecture de rendu unifiée. En d'autres mots, l'interface centralisant les tâches de rendu pour supprimer les processus redondants, le constructeur annonce une baisse de 25 % de la charge de rendu sur le SoC et une diminution de 30 % de l'utilisation de la mémoire RAM.
Des fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA et la sécurité
AI Mind Space est une fonctionnalité orientée vers l'apprentissage et l'organisation. L'outil convertit les documents et liens vidéo enregistrés en informations structurées et recherchables.
Enfin, AI Call Guard, fonctionnant localement sur le smartphone, permet de détecter la falsification de visages par IA, ainsi que l'usage de voix non humaines lors d'appels suspects.

articles.title: Llega a Lidl, el lunes 19 de octubre, la solución para conectar varios dispositivos en altura en patios, terrazas o dentro de casa
articles.text:
Cada semana, Lidl renueva su catálogo con ofertas y novedades de alimentación, decoración y hogar. Algunas rebajadas y otras, sin estarlo, también con una genial relación calidad precio. Y entre estas últimas, en su folleto más reciente nos trae una solución económica para conectar a la toma de luz diferentes aparatos electrónicos en altura. Disponible por 16,99 euros desde el lunes 19 de octubre en tiendas y ya online.
Regleta colgante con 2 ganchos
Como alternativa, si no tenemos ninguna tienda Lidl a mano, preferimos aprovechar la suscripción a Amazon Prime o su prueba gratuita de 30 días (con envíos sin coste y rápidos), encontramos esta otra disponible por 30,46 euros, que ofrece el doble de tomas y cuenta con la función clave de la Parkside de Lidl: permite colgarla de casi cualquier sitio.
Con dos tomas de corriente y un máximo de 3.680 W
El aspecto diferencial de este dispositivo Parkside de Lidl es que incluye un mosquetón metálico integrado en el propio cuerpo de la regleta. Lo que dispara su versatilidad, al dejar colocarla con seguridad y en unos pocos segundos en cualquier lugar de casa, el patio o la terraza que se nos ocurra, siempre y cuando haya algún lugar al que agarrar dicho mosquetón.
Básicamente, sólo debemos tener en cuenta dos requisitos: que haya 5 metros de distancia o menos a la toma de pared (su cable tiene esa longitud) y contemos, como decimos, con algún pomo de puerta, estructura, barra o saliente donde colocar el mosquetón.
Esto permite, elevar del suelo la regleta y contar con dos tomas de corriente a mano en altura. Algo indispensable en algunas situaciones, sobre todo en patios y terrazas, pero también en habitaciones dentro de casa. Todo ello, con una potencia máxima de 3.680 W que admite sin inconvenientes electrodomésticos que consumen mucho.
A tener en cuenta, eso sí, que esta regleta no es apta para un uso continuado en exteriores al no incluir tapas herméticas ni certificación IP44 o superior. Es decir, podemos tenerla al aire libre mientras la usemos, pero debemos resguardarla de la intemperie cuando dejemos de usarla. Además, debe usarse siempre con el cable desenrollado para evitar que se caliente en exceso.

articles.title: LineageOS 24 sauve des millions de smartphones de l'obsolescence en leur offrant Android 17
articles.text:
Le 28 octobre 2021, Google lançait les Pixel 6 et 6 Pro en France à 649 et 899 euros, avec la promesse de cinq ans de mises à jour de sécurité. Le correctif diffusé depuis le 6 octobre est le dernier que la firme garantit aux deux smartphones. Google les avait écartés du programme bêta dès le 20 juillet, avec une mention claire : « l’appareil atteindra sa fin de vie ». Cinq jours plus tard, LineageOS 24 les inscrivait à son programme officiel, Android 17 à la clé.
Une fin de vie actée depuis juillet
Les deux téléphones continueront de fonctionner, mais chaque faille découverte restera désormais sans rustine, un détail qui pèse pour un appareil qui paie sans contact et stocke la moitié de nos comptes. Le Pixel 6a conserve, lui, un sursis jusqu’en juillet 2027, les Pixel 7 tiennent jusqu’en octobre 2027, et Google promet sept ans de suivi à partir des Pixel 8.
Le Pixel 4a a déjà vécu ce scénario : abandonné en août 2023 sur Android 13, il figure toujours au catalogue officiel de LineageOS. La nouvelle version l’emmène jusqu’à Android 17, soit quatre versions majeures après son arrêt. Les Pixel 6 rejoignent la même liste, aux côtés de 27 modèles Google au total, du Pixel 4 de 2019 jusqu’aux Pixel 10.
174 appareils, mais une installation qui se mérite
LineageOS 24 démarre avec 174 appareils, contre 104 pour la version 23.0 lancée un an plus tôt jour pour jour, et 148 pour la 23.2 de février. Les correctifs de sécurité publiés entre août 2025 et octobre 2026 ont par ailleurs été fusionnés sur les branches 18.1 à 24.0.
L’installation réclame toujours un bootloader déverrouillé et une remise à zéro du téléphone. Un outil de flash par navigateur, ouvert en juillet sur flash.lineageos.org, allège une partie de la procédure en gérant les protocoles ADB, Fastboot ou Odin. La compatibilité varie toutefois selon l’appareil, le navigateur et même le câble. Les guides du wiki restent la référence pour chaque modèle, et l’outil n’en dispense pas. Le système arrive enfin sans les services Google, que le projet n’a jamais embarqués et n’embarquera pas.
Depuis le 20 juin 2025, un règlement européen garantit au moins cinq ans de mises à jour du système aux smartphones commercialisés dans l’Union, décomptés à partir de leur mise sur le marché. Sortis quatre ans trop tôt pour en profiter, les Pixel 6 s’arrêtent précisément au plancher que Bruxelles impose désormais aux autres.

articles.title: Le sol s’enfonce sous certaines grandes villes, jusqu’à 21 cm par an : nos satellites ont aussi ausculté Paris
articles.text:
Le sol s’enfonce sous certaines grandes villes, jusqu’à 21 cm par an : nos satellites ont aussi ausculté Paris
Neuf ans d'images radar, 465 villes passées au crible : une équipe de l'université de Pékin publie une carte mondiale des sols urbains qui s'affaissent. Au sommet, Medan, Bandung et Mexico. Et Paris dans tout ça ?
Le bitume sous nos semelles n'a rien d'immuable. Publiée le 12 octobre 2026 dans la revue Nature Cities, une étude pilotée par Shengli Tao et Xie Hu, chercheurs à l'université de Pékin, a mesuré entre 2014 et 2023 les mouvements verticaux du sol dans 465 villes de plus d'un million d'habitants, réparties sur 107 pays. Le phénomène porte un nom, la subsidence : un tassement lent qui lézarde les façades, tord les canalisations et aggrave les inondations. Les auteurs revendiquent la première évaluation planétaire menée avec une méthode homogène, là où les travaux antérieurs juxtaposaient des études locales aux protocoles disparates.
Medan, Bandung, Mexico : les villes où le sol descend le plus vite
À l'échelle d'une agglomération entière, Medan, en Indonésie, détient le triste record avec une vitesse médiane d'environ 33 mm par an, devant Bandung (22 mm), Torreón au Mexique (17 mm) et Ispahan en Iran (11 mm). Mexico affiche une médiane plus modeste, 8 mm, mais certains de ses quartiers plongent d'environ 217 mm chaque année. Plus de 21 cm. Le pompage intensif des nappes phréatiques figure parmi les grands coupables : privées d'eau, les couches de sédiments se tassent comme une éponge qu'on essore.
Un autre satellite confirme l'ampleur du phénomène. Lancé en juillet 2025 par la NASA et l'agence spatiale indienne, NISAR a vu plusieurs secteurs de la capitale mexicaine perdre plus de 2 cm par mois entre octobre 2025 et janvier 2026.
The ground beneath Mexico City is slowly sinking, and now, the NISAR satellite can track it from space. 
New data shows parts of the city (in blue) that sank more than half an inch (more than 2 cm) per month from Oct. 2025 to Jan. 2026. pic.twitter.com/5uDM1B9Mwx
— NASA Earth (@NASAEarth) April 29, 2026
L'Asie du Sud-Est et de l'Est offre un tableau contrasté. Nombre de villes y ralentissent leur descente, signe selon les auteurs que des mesures d'atténuation d'envergure portent leurs fruits, tandis que de vastes zones urbaines de ces mêmes régions continuent d'accélérer. La carte fait aussi émerger des territoires longtemps délaissés par la recherche, en Afrique, en Amérique du Sud et en Russie.
Sentinel-1 en vigie, Paris sur la terre ferme
La prouesse repose sur l'interférométrie radar (InSAR) appliquée aux images de Sentinel-1, la constellation du programme européen Copernicus. D'un passage à l'autre, le décalage de phase des ondes réfléchies trahit des variations millimétriques, cartographiées avec une résolution de 40 mètres.
Ce tour du monde porte une signature chinoise, mais il s'appuie sur des yeux européens. Pilotés par l'Union européenne et l'Agence spatiale européenne, ces satellites livrent leurs images gratuitement aux chercheurs du monde entier. La flotte vient d'ailleurs de rajeunir : Sentinel-1C a rejoint l'orbite en décembre 2024 à bord d'une Vega-C, suivi de Sentinel-1D en novembre 2025, propulsé par Ariane 6 depuis Kourou.
Bonne nouvelle pour l'Hexagone : dans les données publiées par l'équipe, Paris, Lyon et Marseille bougent de moins d'un millimètre par an, une valeur à la limite de ce que la méthode sait distinguer, comme Londres ou Tokyo. L'Italie mérite davantage d'attention. Florence et Rome descendent de 2 à 3 mm par an en médiane, et leurs secteurs les plus instables dépassent 15 mm, selon le même indicateur qui attribue 217 mm à Mexico.
Les 465 villes de l'étude se consultent sur le portail interactif GUS, mis en ligne par les chercheurs. Ceux-ci reconnaissent leurs angles morts : des mesures relatives, bornées aux limites administratives des villes, et moins fiables là où les stations GPS au sol se font rares. Pour le reste de la France, l'EGMS, le service européen de surveillance des mouvements du sol, exploite ces mêmes radars Sentinel-1 pour cartographier le continent au millimètre près, quartier par quartier.
Source : Nature Cities

articles.title: OpenAI fires Saudi employee accused of planting a bug in its executive conference room - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
OpenAI fires Saudi employee accused of planting a bug in its executive conference room
OpenAI Group PBC called in the Federal Bureau of Investigation to come and arrest one of its employees after a “sophisticated recording device” was discovered hidden within the artificial intelligence company’s executive conference room.
Abdulrahman Alfozan (pictured in a CCTV image), a 35-year-old Saudi Arabian national, was arrested on Friday and appeared in a federal court earlier today, where he was charged with illegally intercepting oral communications, according to a news release by the Department of Justice.
The device was discovered by OpenAI on Sept. 30. It had been inserted into a USB port on the back of a television inside the executive conference room located at one of the company’s offices in San Francisco. OpenAI said its investigations showed that the device had been installed just a couple of days earlier and concealed in toilet paper. They could not ascertain what communications had been recorded, as the device had been encrypted.
“We used our models to understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier,” OpenAI said in a post on X. “At this time, we have no indications of this individual inappropriately accessing or exfiltrating model weights, source code or customer data.”
An investigation by the FBI revealed that Alfozan had used a productivity tool to learn about OpenAI’s meeting rooms, its calendars and “leadership and exec” locations, according to OpenAI’s official complaint. A chatbot associated with the suspect’s spouse showed that someone had used it to ask questions about installing and remotely accessing a recording device. That account, which shared multiple identifiers and attributes with Alfozan’s own chatbot account, was also prompted for information about continuous audio recording and Wi-Fi.
The DOJ said in its statement that Alfozan, who had worked with OpenAI as an engineer on one of its product teams since July 2025, was spotted by CCTV cameras going close to, and entering the conference room multiple times before the device was found, despite having no authorization to enter that room. It added that meetings within the conference room “frequently involved discussions of highly confidential technical, commercial and strategic information, including proprietary research, product plans and business-development opportunities.”
Following Alfozan’s arrest, company officials discovered a bag belonging to him that contained a second recording device identical to the one found earlier.
We discovered a sophisticated recording device that was hidden inside one of our offices. We used our models to understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier. We referred the matter to the FBI, and we’re…
— OpenAI Newsroom (@OpenAINewsroom) October 13, 2026
Alfozan has since been fired by OpenAI. According to the DOJ, he faces a maximum penalty of five years imprisonment, a potential fine of up to $250,000 and three years of supervised release if found guilty of the charges. “For us, it is a matter of national security,” U.S. Attorney Craig Missakian for the Northern District of California said in a statement. “This arrest highlights our relentless efforts in partnership with the FBI to identify and prosecute those who seek to steal our technology, as alleged in the complaint.”
The incident comes at a time of heightened scrutiny around safety and security in the AI industry, following a number of cyber incidents involving autonomous AI agents, which escaped their testing environments and hacked into third-party systems. Dario Amodei, chief executive of OpenAI rival Anthropic PBC, has called on the industry to coordinate an industry-wide slowdown on the development of frontier AI models so that such systems can be evaluated for safety by neutral experts. Though no agreement on how to implement a slowdown has been agreed upon, OpenAI last month called off the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra, which fell short of its bar for staying within scope and authorization.
Last week, OpenAI stirred up further controversy when it fired three of its safety researchers, alleging they were guilty of a “significant breach of trust” after they “violated clear policies on handling sensitive information.”
The researchers – Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita Balesni – raised safety concerns in a letter to OpenAI’s executive leadership, saying that communications around their exit from the company “have made our former colleagues afraid to speak and operate in ways that, until last week, were an integral part of working at OpenAI.”

articles.title: Solo 30 dólares cobra un ciberdelincuente por atacar una página web: cuesta menos que Netflix
articles.text:
Un ataque contra una página web puede contratarse desde 30 dólares, un coste comparable al de una suscripción de streaming, según un análisis de ciberseguridad.
La investigación realizada por Kaspersky, revela que algunos servicios de ataque por denegación de servicio distribuido, conocidos como DDoS, incluso se comercializan mediante suscripciones desde un dólar.
El dato expone la reducción de barreras para afectar sitios web, aplicaciones y plataformas digitales. Un ataque DDoS busca saturar un servicio con solicitudes o tráfico hasta ralentizarlo o dejarlo fuera de línea. Para una empresa, la interrupción puede afectar ventas, atención al cliente, pagos y sistemas necesarios para su actividad diaria.
El mercado clandestino ofrece ataques por entre 30 y 2.000 dólares
La investigación de Kaspersky examinó más de 256.000 publicaciones vinculadas con ataques DDoS en la web profunda y la web oscura. El análisis identificó a 148 actores que permanecen activos al menos desde 2024 y que ofrecen servicios, herramientas o infraestructura para ejecutar estas acciones.
Los precios dependen del objetivo, la duración y las características solicitadas. Los ataques por encargo oscilan entre 30 y 2.000 dólares, mientras ciertos servicios de suscripción ofrecen acceso a herramientas desde un dólar. Ese modelo permite que el comprador utilice plataformas en línea o bots de mensajería para lanzar ataques.
La oferta se organiza en tres grupos principales. El primero reúne a quienes realizan el ataque por encargo. El segundo vende suscripciones para que el cliente acceda a herramientas destinadas a saturar servicios digitales. El tercero opera con infraestructura propia para ejecutar las acciones.
Sitios web y aplicaciones concentran la mayor parte de las ofertas
La disponibilidad de páginas web, aplicaciones y plataformas es el principal objetivo de estos servicios. El informe indica que el 92% de los actores analizados promocionaba métodos dirigidos a servicios expuestos en Internet. A su vez, el 74% ofrecía técnicas destinadas a afectar la infraestructura que sostiene esos sistemas.
Los datos reflejan que los ciberdelincuentes buscan interrumpir canales esenciales para la relación entre las empresas y sus usuarios. Una tienda en línea que deja de funcionar puede perder transacciones; una aplicación de atención puede impedir consultas; y una plataforma interna puede retrasar procesos operativos.
La comercialización también se distribuye en varios canales. Entre los actores que venden ataques por encargo, el 65% utiliza foros especializados en ciberdelincuencia. El 35% restante recurre a Telegram y Discord para promocionar sus servicios y contactar con posibles compradores.
La facilidad de acceso eleva el riesgo para las organizaciones
Joao Brandao, analista de Huella Digital de Kaspersky, advirtió que el problema no se limita a la existencia de ataques DDoS, sino a la facilidad con la que pueden adquirirse. “Cuando un servicio capaz de afectar la operación digital de una empresa puede conseguirse por un precio comparable al de una plataforma de streaming o incluso una taza de café, la barrera de entrada para los atacantes disminuye”, señaló.
La interrupción de un servicio puede generar efectos incluso después de recuperar la actividad. Las empresas pueden enfrentar operaciones incompletas, presión sobre sus equipos técnicos, quejas de usuarios y costes asociados a la recuperación. La disponibilidad digital se ha convertido en una condición básica para compañías que dependen del comercio electrónico, las aplicaciones y los canales de atención remota.
El crecimiento de servicios listos para contratar reduce la necesidad de conocimientos técnicos avanzados. Un actor que antes necesitaba infraestructura y experiencia puede intentar comprar capacidades externas, aunque la efectividad del ataque depende de distintos factores y de las defensas del objetivo.
Medidas para reducir la exposición a ataques DDoS
La compañía de seguridad digital recomienda identificar primero qué servicios no pueden dejar de funcionar. Sitios web, pasarelas de pago, aplicaciones de clientes y sistemas internos deben quedar priorizados para definir medidas de protección y continuidad.
También aconseja establecer un plan de respuesta antes de cualquier incidente. Ese documento debe definir responsables, canales de comunicación y pasos de recuperación. La planificación previa reduce la improvisación cuando un servicio ya presenta problemas.
Otras recomendaciones incluyen:
- Supervisar aumentos inusuales de tráfico y caídas repentinas del rendimiento
- Revisar patrones anómalos en aplicaciones y redes
- Mantener visibilidad sobre riesgos externos
- Preparar a los empleados para reconocer incidentes
- Contar con apoyo técnico especializado para responder con rapidez
La prevención ya no depende solo de grandes organizaciones con recursos amplios, sino de la capacidad de proteger los servicios que sostienen su operación digital.

articles.title: Apple Announces the Next Generation of HomePod mini
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Apple Announces the Next Generation of HomePod mini
Apple today announced HomePod mini 2, featuring Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and enhanced audio experiences. Siri AI, coming to HomePod mini 2 in a future software update, is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding, broad world knowledge that powers tasks like richer music discovery, and the ability to tap into even more apps—bringing a whole new level of capability to HomePod mini.
Users can enjoy room-filling audio with a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or using multiroom audio. When paired with the new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2 supports four-speaker surround sound—Apple's most immersive home theater setup yet. And HomePod mini makes it easy for different users to manage the connected home with just a voice command, securely controlling accessories and running automations.HomePod mini 2 can be pre-ordered starting today in pink, green, blue, white, and midnight, with availability beginning Friday, October 30.
Kaiann Drance, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Home Product Marketing"HomePod mini 2 brings together Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and incredible audio. With Siri AI, it understands you better than ever, drawing on personal context and broad world knowledge to make music discovery even richer. It fills a room with sound on its own, which gets even bigger in a stereo pair or with multiroom audio, and when paired with the new Apple TV 4K, it delivers our most immersive home theater setup yet. And with just your voice, HomePod mini makes it easy to securely control your accessories and run automations across the connected home."
Siri AI Transforms the HomePod mini Experience
Powered by an entirely new architecture built on the latest generation of Apple Foundation Models, Siri AI transforms the HomePod mini experience and helps users get more done than ever before.
When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, HomePod mini can tap into a user's personal context to help them find what they need in the moment. HomePod mini can recognize up to six users in a household by their voice and securely connect to their device across apps like Messages and timers, while playing their favorite music, and more. Siri AI can also privately act on this context across a user's iPhone and iPad apps to complete tasks like finding a song a friend recommended in a text, setting a reminder tied to a calendar event or location, locating a recipe from an email, or adding ingredients to a grocery list. With broad world knowledge, Siri AI can answer questions on almost any topic by getting up-to-date information from the web. And users can go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before.
Once Siri AI is enabled on a supported HomePod mini speaker, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI's broad world knowledge; its ability to have rich, natural conversations; and its improved music discovery.
Immersive Audio Experiences
HomePod mini delivers rich 360-degree sound from its compact footprint, whether it's used as a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or as part of a multiroom audio setup. Powered by the Apple S10 chip and advanced computational audio, it analyzes music in real time to optimize dynamic range, loudness, and acoustic performance. For the first time, users can create a four-speaker surround sound experience with Apple TV 4K (4th generation) and HomePod mini 2. Together, the four speakers and the new Apple TV 4K intelligently recognize each speaker's position in the room, so audio timing and levels are automatically calibrated to the space.The new HomePod mini can serve as a speaker for Mac, delivering expansive sound for everything from movies and gaming to FaceTime and video calls. Finished in complementary colors, the new HomePod mini creates a beautifully unified desktop setup with Mac.
Introducing Sound Glow
With Sound Glow, the top of HomePod mini transforms into a visual canvas that glows and pulses in sync with the music, reacting in real time to bass and treble. The song's album artwork from Now Playing generates a color-matched light experience that's unique to every song, and users can pick a soundscape like rain to trigger bespoke animations for a soothing atmosphere.
Effortless Smart Home Management
HomePod mini makes controlling the connected home easy at an incredible value. With just their voice, users can conduct a series of smart home actions, including locking the front door; closing the garage when leaving the house; and lowering the blinds, adjusting the thermostat, or turning off the lights at bedtime. With the Home app, users can automate their smart home accessories and create scenes to control multiple accessories at the same time. As a home hub, HomePod mini also lets users securely control accessories from the Home app on iPhone, whether they're at home or away.Sound Recognition gives HomePod mini users peace of mind by listening for a smoke or carbon monoxide alarm and, if one is detected, sending a notification immediately to the user's iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Using the Home app, users can check in via HomePod mini and listen and talk to someone at home to make sure everything is all right.
The new HomePod mini also works seamlessly with smart home accessories, including Apple Home Collection video doorbells and cameras, using Face Recognition to announce who is at the door.
Private and Secure by Design
As with every Apple product, privacy and security are foundational to HomePod mini. Siri AI takes full advantage of the bold new architecture for Apple Intelligence. Siri requests on HomePod mini 2 can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud. When processed in Private Cloud Compute, data is not stored or made accessible to Apple or anyone else.
With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world's most private digital assistant.
HomePod mini 2 and the Environment
HomePod mini 2 is built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple's ambitious plan to be carbon-neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. HomePod mini features 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, and 100 percent recycled copper, gold plating, and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards. HomePod mini 2 meets Apple's high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based and designed to be recycled.Pricing and Availability
- Customers in the U.S. and more than 23 other countries and regions can pre-order HomePod mini 2 starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in pink, green, blue, white, and midnight, with availability in stores beginning Friday, October 30.
- HomePod mini 2 is available for $149 (U.S.).
- Siri AI will be available in English on HomePod mini 2 via a future software update in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the UK.
- HomePod mini 2 is compatible with HomePod software 27.2.

articles.title: Google Wallet just got a useful new feature for receipt hoarders — plus three other updates that make it slicker to use
articles.text:
Google Wallet is getting 4 handy upgrades — including the ability to scan and organize your receipts
Four more reasons to ditch your physical wallet
- The latest Google Play Services update brings four upgrades to Google Wallet
- The biggest of these is the ability to scan and store receipts
- It also adds an in-app message center, improved merchant names, and a smoother payment process
If you have an Android phone then you’re probably already using Google Wallet, and with the latest Google Play Services update it’s getting slightly better in four ways.
As spotted by Android Police, the October Google Play Services update (v26.40) is rolling out now, and it — among other things — brings the ability to scan receipts into Google Wallet, so you’ll be able to save and view them in the wallet interface.
Additionally, this update improves merchant names in transaction notifications. Google hasn’t specified how they’re improved, but presumably this is aimed at providing more clarity about who or what you’ve sent money to.
More messages and fewer payment screens
The update also adds an in-app message center to Google Wallet, and while it’s not clear what kind of messages you might receive, we can imagine they might for example tell you about updates to the service — such as the ones we’re writing about here.
Finally, if you use Google Pay through Chrome for Android, the update lets you now “skip the Payment Request UI when you provide merchants with your name, email, and phone number.” That presumably makes for a faster, smoother payment process.
So while none of these upgrades are individually massive, combined they should make for a notable difference to your Google Pay experience.
The update will roll out automatically, so if you’re not seeing these changes yet, you likely will do soon. But to check what version of Google Play Services you have, you can head to Settings > Apps > Google Play Services, and you should see the version number at the bottom of this screen.
