articles.title: Face à OpenAI et Anthropic, Google dégaine Gemini 4 Argon pour revenir dans la course
articles.text:
Moins de deux semaines après son annonce le 30 septembre dernier, il est là : Gemini 4 Argon, le nouveau modèle de frontière de Google, commence son déploiement mondial ce 13 octobre 2026.
Lors de sa présentation, Google affirmait que son nouveau modèle d’IA haut de gamme surpassait GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI) et Claude Fable 5 (Anthropic) dans les benchmarks. Désormais, l’entreprise préfère mettre en avant des résultats plus concrets, obtenus en interne et auprès d’une poignée de clients privilégiés.
Car l’enjeu est de taille pour Google, distancé par ses concurrents depuis le printemps 2026. Le groupe avait promis l’arrivée de Gemini 3.5 Pro en mai, mais ce modèle n’a jamais vu le jour, sur fond de rumeurs évoquant des performances décevantes. Depuis, Google avait surtout multiplié les versions intermédiaires, jusqu’à Gemini 3.8 Flash, lancé début septembre, sans proposer de véritable successeur à sa gamme Pro.
Face au rythme imposé par OpenAI et Anthropic, Google espère donc reprendre la main avec Argon. Son nouveau modèle cible notamment les tâches longues et complexes, qui nécessitent d’enchaîner plusieurs étapes, dans des domaines comme le développement logiciel, la finance, le droit, la cybersécurité ou encore la recherche scientifique.
Qui a accès à Gemini 4 Argon ?
Concrètement, Gemini 4 Argon est accessible aux développeurs et aux entreprises via l’API Gemini et les offres Gemini Enterprise éligibles. Côté grand public, les abonnés Google AI Pro et Ultra peuvent l’utiliser dans l’application Gemini et le mode IA de Google Search. Son intégration à Google Antigravity, l’outil de développement assisté par IA, est en revanche réservée aux abonnés Ultra.
C’est justement au sein d’Antigravity — l’outil de développement de Google où des agents d’IA écrivent et suggèrent du code — qu’Argon s’est d’abord illustré. D’après l’entreprise, les soumissions de code générées par ces agents ont bondi de plus de 35 % ces dernières semaines dans ses propres équipes, tandis que les retours en arrière (le code annulé car défectueux) ont chuté de près d’un tiers.
Google cite notamment le cas de l’équipe Chrome. Chromium, la base open source du navigateur, compte pas moins de 40 millions de lignes de code. Argon a aidé les ingénieurs à extraire la gestion centrale des pages web d’un vieux dossier fourre-tout d’environ 6 millions de lignes. Résultat : plusieurs mois de travail auraient été abattus en l’espace de quelques semaines seulement, selon l’entreprise.
Si ces chiffres — mesurés par Google sur ses propres équipes — sont flatteurs, il faut admettre que la concurrence est rude. OpenAI et Anthropic disposent déjà de leurs propres agents de programmation (Codex et Claude Code), des outils solidement implantés auprès des développeurs et des entreprises.
Des juristes aux physiciens : qui utilise déjà Argon ?
Avant cette ouverture générale, Google a éprouvé Argon auprès de quelques partenaires en accès anticipé. Parmi eux : le cabinet Deloitte, l’éditeur juridique LexisNexis, la start-up médicale Ambience Healthcare ou encore Isomorphic Labs, la filiale d’Alphabet dédiée à la découverte de médicaments. Leurs cas d’usage couvrent la synthèse documentaire, le raisonnement sur de vastes bases de code, ou encore l’analyse de données longitudinales, comme le suivi d’un dossier patient sur plusieurs années.
En cybersécurité, l’entreprise Wiz a intégré le modèle à son initiative « Scan for Good ». En corrélant des bugs complexes pour neutraliser des failles critiques, Argon aurait permis de protéger des centaines de milliers de dossiers médicaux confidentiels. Un succès qui a incité Google à ouvrir son programme de cyberdéfense (Fairwind Program) à des centaines de nouveaux acteurs.
Comme pour les autres modèles du marché, ces performances impressionnantes restent toutefois à nuancer : les chiffres avancés proviennent de Google lui-même.
L’entreprise dispose néanmoins d’un argument de poids : son tarif. À 2 dollars par million de tokens en entrée et 10 dollars en sortie, Argon coûte cinq fois moins cher que GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI) et Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic), et deux fois moins que Claude Opus 5.5. Mais cet avantage est temporaire : dès le 1er décembre 2026, les prix passeront à 4 et 20 dollars, soit le même niveau que Claude Opus 5.5. Enfin, il reste une question de taille : ce modèle signe-t-il la fin de la gamme « Pro » de Google ?

articles.title: Microsoft releases Windows 10 KB5126657 extended security update
articles.text:
Microsoft released the Windows 10 KB5126657 extended security update, which includes this month's record-breaking October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes and a few bug fixes and changes.
If you are running Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC or are enrolled in the ESU program, you can install this update like normal by going into Settings, clicking on Windows Update, and manually performing a 'Check for Updates.'
After installing this update, Windows 10 will be updated to build 19045.7807, and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021 will be updated to build 19044.7807.
What's new in Windows 10 KB5126657
Microsoft no longer releases new features for Windows 10, and the KB5126657 update mainly includes security updates and bug fixes.
The update also includes fixes released as part of today's record-breaking October 2026 Patch Tuesday, which fixed a massive 1,411 vulnerabilities across Microsoft's products, including one actively exploited zero-day flaw.
The complete list of fixes and changes in KB5126657 is listed below:
- [Time and Date]
  - This update enables permanent Daylight Savings Time (DST) support for British Columbia and Alberta starting in November 2026.
  - This update introduces the new time zone Manitoba Standard Time "(UTC-5:00) Manitoba".
- [ReFS security] This update adds auditing and optional policy controls for ReFS volumes on externally attached storage devices. Auditing is enabled by default, while enforcement controls remain disabled by default to give administrators time to evaluate and prepare for future security hardening changes. To learn more, see KB5130741.
- [Storage Spaces] Addresses an issue that might cause some Storage Spaces Direct virtual disks to remain offline after installing a Windows update. This issue occurs when valid tiered storage metadata is incorrectly identified as invalid during recovery, preventing affected virtual disks and dependent workloads from coming online.
- [File History (known issue)] Fixed: This update addresses an issue where File History might fail to back up or restore files to an external drive or network location. Affected devices might incorrectly display a "Reconnect your drive" message even when a compatible backup drive is connected and working properly.
- [Secure Boot] This update continues the deployment of updated Secure Boot certificates using the latest high-confidence targeting data to identify eligible devices that are ready to automatically receive the new certificates. Deployment through Windows Update remains ongoing across supported device.
Microsoft says the update has a known issue affecting some USB Audio Class 1.0 devices after installing the September 2026 Windows security updates.
Affected devices may fail to start with a Code 10 error in Device Manager, stop producing audio, or experience unresponsive volume controls and sound settings. Some devices may also work in standard stereo mode but fail when using 8-channel or 3D audio configurations.
Microsoft partially fixed the issue in an emergency out-of-band update released on September 14, which addressed problems with 8-channel and 3D audio modes.
However, other audio issues remain unresolved, and Microsoft says it is working on additional fixes.

articles.title: Priyank Kharge on Karnataka’s plans to drive tech growth beyond Bengaluru
articles.text:
Priyank Kharge on Karnataka’s plans to drive tech growth beyond Bengaluru
At TechSparks 2026, Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home Affairs, IT, Biotechnology, and E-Governance, Govt. of Karnataka, highlighted the state’s Beyond Bengaluru policy.
Karnataka’s strategy to ease pressure on Bengaluru is to bring investment to where talent already exists, rather than making talent come to where the investment is, Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home Affairs, Information Technology, Biotechnology, and E-Governance, Govt. of Karnataka, said.
The minister was speaking on the sidelines of TechSparks, YourStory’s flagship startup and technology event. In a fireside chat with Shradha Sharma, Founder & CEO, YourStory and Bharat Project, Kharge spoke about the government’s plans to create opportunities for startups and talent beyond Bengaluru through targeted policies, infrastructure and region-specific centres of excellence.
“Because of the government’s constant push on its Beyond Bengaluru Mission and local economic acceleration programmes, Mysuru is today delivering close to Rs 4,000 crore in IT exports, Mangaluru close to Rs 3,500 crore, and Hubballi-Belagavi-Dharwad close to Rs 3,000 crore,” the minister highlighted.
He said manufacturing units and global capability centres (GCCs) have come up across the state, and that one of Apple’s supply chain partners operates out of Belagavi, doing precision manufacturing. The state has also announced a Bioeconomy Mission covering biotech and agritech, along with related schemes.
Kharge said the state runs dedicated entrepreneurship programmes for startups outside Bengaluru and cited recent deals to emphasise the state’s Beyond Bengaluru policy.
He said NTT acquired two Udupi-based startups for an undisclosed sum. There have also been acquisitions involving semiconductor design companies in Belagavi and Mangaluru.
He added that the founders involved are only 23 or 24 years old.
The government is setting up centres of excellence matched to each region’s strengths, Kharge said. “Wherever there is innovation possible, wherever we are able to ensure that the demography or the talent is good, we are tailor-making policies for that region, and we are ensuring that we accelerate growth,” he said.
“The government is extremely serious about this, which is why we are building centres of excellence based on each region’s geography and demography. We have an AI centre of excellence at IIIT Dharwad and another at IIIT Raichur. We have an agritech centre in Kalaburagi, and we are setting up a horticulture centre in Bagalkot. Wherever innovation is possible and talent is strong, we tailor policies for that region to accelerate growth,” he added.

articles.title: Les smartphones de nombreux Français vont sonner ce mardi, voici pourquoi
articles.text:
La Journée nationale de la résilience revient ce mardi 13 octobre pour sa cinquième édition, avec son lot d’exercices de sécurité civile aux quatre coins du pays. Les préfets de plusieurs départements en profitent pour déclencher FR-Alert, le dispositif qui envoie une notification d’urgence sur tous les téléphones présents dans une zone de danger. Des dizaines de milliers de Français vont donc voir leur smartphone hurler entre 9 h et 17 h, sans qu’aucune menace ne plane réellement sur eux.
Des sites SEVESO au vent violent, le tour de France des scénarios
En Seine-et-Marne, 56 communes situées dans le périmètre d’un site SEVESO doté d’un plan particulier d’intervention recevront la notification entre 9 h et 10 h. Le message y sera précédé de la mention « EXERCICE », répétée trois fois, histoire d’éviter tout quiproquo avec les habitants des zones concernées.
Dans le Lot, l’alerte accompagne un exercice organisé de 9 h à 12 h autour du site SNCF de Biars-sur-Cère, avec des sirènes à Biars-sur-Cère, Bretenoux et Girac en prime. La Dordogne déclenche de son côté un scénario de vents violents à 9 h, pour une trentaine de minutes, dans un rayon de dix kilomètres autour de Brantôme. Le Maine-et-Loire ferme la marche l’après-midi, de 14 h à 17 h, autour du site Zach System installé entre Avrillé et Montreuil-Juigné, aux portes d’Angers. L’Oise, la Saône-et-Loire et la Sarthe figureraient également au programme du jour, et d’autres secteurs prendraient le relais jeudi 15 octobre. Le Finistère devrait suivre dès le mercredi 14 octobre, avec un exercice de submersion marine annoncé par la préfecture dans quatre communes du département.
Une sonnerie qui perce même le mode silencieux
FR-Alert fonctionne par diffusion cellulaire : l’antenne relais arrose tous les téléphones présents dans sa zone, comme un haut-parleur de gare s’adresse à tout le quai sans connaître le nom des voyageurs. Aucune application à installer, aucune inscription, et aucune donnée personnelle collectée au passage : le dispositif, imposé par une directive européenne de 2018, est en service depuis juin 2022. Seuls les téléphones éteints ou en mode avion passeront entre les mailles du filet, le mode silencieux ne protégeant de rien.
Si la notification s’affiche sur votre écran ce mardi, aucune action n’est attendue de votre part : inutile d’appeler les secours ou la mairie, et pas question de consulter le message au volant. Le dispositif complète le réseau d’alerte historique et ses plus de 2 000 sirènes, celles qui retentissent le premier mercredi du mois à midi. Les habitants d’Île-de-France se souviennent peut-être du précédent de mai 2024, quand un message estampillé « Alerte extrêmement grave » détaillait la sécurité des Jeux olympiques. L’épisode avait valu au ministère de l’Intérieur une question écrite à l’Assemblée nationale.

articles.title: The developer who cloned Photoshop using AI has now created Word, Excel, and PowerPoint replicas with Claude
articles.text:
First look: Though vibe-coded apps are often slammed as "AI slop" by users and developers alike, generative AI can now produce complex productivity apps that rival market leaders. After building free, open-source alternatives to Adobe's Creative Cloud apps using Claude AI, developer Brandon Thomas is now turning to replicas of Microsoft Office apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Called WordCraft, GridCraft, and DeckCraft, respectively, the open-source applications are written in Rust with Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5, as the Adobe replicas were, and are available for download under MIT or Apache 2.0 licenses. They are, however, still at a relatively early stage of development and need a lot more work before they can be considered viable alternatives to Microsoft Office.
According to its GitHub page, WordCraft is an "open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word" that runs natively on Windows, macOS, Linux, and BSD. It can also be used in the browser via WebAssembly. The app uses a single Rust codebase for all platforms, without falling back on Electron or Tauri.
WordCraft reads and writes .docx, the native file format of Microsoft Word. It also supports a range of other formats, including .odt, .rtf, .html, .md, and .txt, and can import the legacy .doc format. It can export PDFs with real, selectable text, links, and bookmarks, too. Thomas noted that spelling, grammar, and many other critical features work offline.
WordCraft is visually almost identical to the software it's modeled after, offering the same ribbon, styles, tables, track changes, and references as Word. It also implements features like mail merge, which lets users create personalized letters by pulling in data from a CSV file or Outlook contacts list.
GridCraft, which replicates Microsoft Excel, already implements 89% of Excel's ribbon and menu commands, according to the developer, and about 98% of its worksheet functions. It offers Excel's familiar interface, including the ribbon, formula bar, keyboard shortcuts, and more. It uses .xlsx as its native file format and is fully scriptable by AI agents.
DeckCraft, which opens and saves .pptx files, aims for full feature parity with PowerPoint and to be "better and faster" than the original. Its GitHub page claims 79% "feature parity" across 191 PowerPoint features, including advanced formatting, and export to PDF.
WordCraft development is the furthest along, with 88% of Word's ribbon-based commands implemented.
Overall, the project estimates it has reached around 60% feature parity with the Microsoft app. All three apps are in alpha, with GridCraft around 50% "ready for real work" and DeckCraft around 55%.

articles.title: Meta lanza nuevas gafas inteligentes sin cámara desde 349 dólares: permiten usar Meta AI sin acudir al celular
articles.text:
Ray-Ban Meta Audio son las nuevas gafas inteligentes sin cámara de Meta, enfocadas en la reproducción de música, podcast, llamadas y el uso del asistente de inteligencia artificial Meta AI con manos libres. El precio parte de USD 349 y ya se encuentran disponibles.
Las gafas, desarrolladas junto con EssilorLuxottica, no incorporan cámara y apuntan a concentrar sus funciones en el audio y la interacción por voz. El modelo llega en dos diseños, Clubmaster y Burbank, compatibles con lentes graduados.
Características de las nuevas gafas de Meta
Las gafas Ray-Ban Meta Audio permiten escuchar música y podcast, realizar llamadas y usar el asistente de inteligencia artificial de la compañía sin sacar el teléfono. Meta las presenta como sus primeras gafas centradas exclusivamente en el audio.
El dispositivo pesa 43 gramos e incluye puntas de varillas ajustables, plaquetas nasales intercambiables y bisagras de sobreextensión. La batería ofrece hasta 12 horas de uso con una sola carga.
El estuche incluido suma hasta 48 horas adicionales de autonomía. Las gafas estarán disponibles en 23 combinaciones de colores y lentes, distribuidas entre los modelos Clubmaster y Burbank.
Por qué Meta quitó las cámaras de sus gafas
La decisión de lanzar un modelo sin cámara se produce en un contexto de preocupación por la privacidad, la grabación clandestina y la protección de datos asociados a las gafas inteligentes con capacidad de registrar imágenes y video.
El Servicio de Tribunales de Su Majestad prohibió el uso de las Ray-Ban Meta en todos los juzgados y tribunales de Inglaterra y Gales, con la orden de confiscarlas en los accesos.
En Inglaterra, teatros, cines, restaurantes, pubs y bares han impuesto restricciones al ingreso o uso de gafas inteligentes con cámara por el riesgo de que los clientes sean grabados sin su consentimiento.
La Asociación de Cines del Reino Unido advirtió que varios operadores evalúan limitar o prohibir estos dispositivos por cuestiones de privacidad y piratería audiovisual.
Asimismo, existen restricciones similares en tribunales de Nueva York. Por su parte, el Servicio de Inmigración y Control de Aduanas de Estados Unidos prohibió a sus empleados utilizar estos dispositivos en espacios de trabajo federales, al considerarlos cámaras corporales no autorizadas.
Meta lanzó Muse Wonder, una nueva familia de IA
Meta lanzó Muse Wonder, una nueva familia de modelos de inteligencia artificial orientada a asistentes capaces de resolver tareas personales y profesionales con mayor autonomía.
La nueva línea estará disponible para desarrolladores mediante Meta Model API y Muse Code. Muse Wonder Full, la versión de mayor capacidad, podrá utilizarse inicialmente a través de las suscripciones de Muse Code.
Meta busca que estos modelos puedan asistir a los usuarios en procesos que requieren varios pasos, como interpretar un contrato de alquiler, gestionar un reclamo ante una aseguradora, ordenar información financiera o crear una aplicación.
La empresa aseguró que Muse Wonder también llegará a su asistente Muse, primero para los suscriptores.
Muse Wonder incorpora dos funciones que Meta denomina Active Memory y Active Focus. La primera permite que el sistema conserve información de conversaciones anteriores y recupere detalles relevantes para cumplir una nueva solicitud.
La segunda busca que el modelo mantenga la atención sobre el objetivo, pruebe distintas alternativas y ajuste su plan cuando encuentra obstáculos.
Según Meta, los modelos fueron entrenados para operar en un navegador y entre distintas aplicaciones. De ese modo, pueden construir un plan de acción a partir de las preferencias y circunstancias del usuario, en lugar de limitarse a responder preguntas aisladas.
La compañía afirmó que Muse Wonder fue diseñado para tareas complejas en ámbitos como derecho, finanzas, salud y programación. También señaló que el modelo puede utilizarse para desarrollar desde videojuegos hasta herramientas para pequeños negocios.
El lanzamiento es parte de la estrategia de Meta para competir con los modelos de frontera de OpenAI y Anthropic. La empresa presentó a Muse Wonder como un paso hacia su objetivo de desarrollar una “superinteligencia personal”, capaz de comprender metas y preferencias de cada usuario.

articles.title: Apple renova linha HomePod mini após seis anos sem novidades • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Apple renova linha HomePod mini após seis anos sem novidades
Caixa de som compacta ganha suporte à Apple Intelligence, novo recurso de luz e áudio surround com a Apple TV 4K.
Como parte dos lançamentos de suas linhas de produtos para casa, a Apple anunciou nesta terça-feira (13/10) o HomePod mini 2, nova geração da caixa de som inteligente compacta. O aparelho mantém o formato esférico do modelo de 2020, mas recebe o chip S10 e recursos de conectividade atualizados.
Entre as novidades estão o Sound Glow e possibilidades para integrar a caixa com sistemas de som externos. Já a nova Siri AI, um dos recursos previstos para o modelo, só será liberada em uma atualização futura. A linha, que mantém o design original, chega em cinco opções de cores: rosa, verde, azul, branco e meia-noite.
As pré-vendas já começaram nos Estados Unidos por US$ 149 (cerca de R$ 747, em conversão direta). A Apple não anunciou, até o momento, o preço ou se a nova geração chegará ao Brasil.
A mudança visual mais evidente está na superfície iluminada no topo. Com o Sound Glow, as luzes acompanham as cores da arte do álbum reproduzido e mudam em sincronia com a música. O recurso também funciona com os sons ambientes oferecidos pela Apple, como chuva, floresta e oceano.
Por dentro, a Apple segue o padrão da linha ao incluir um processador de smartwatch. Desta vez, foi o chip Apple S10, usado no Apple Watch Series 10, de 2024. Com isso, o aparelho passa a oferecer o Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 6 e suporte aos padrões Thread e Matter, usados na conexão e na comunicação entre dispositivos de casa inteligente.
Não houve uma reformulação significativa dos componentes de áudio, mas a empresa trouxe novos recursos que ampliam a usabilidade da caixinha:
Também é possível combinar dois HomePod mini 2 com duas unidades do HomePod de segunda geração, por exemplo, para ampliar a experiência, segundo a Apple.
Quando chegar, a Siri AI deverá permitir conversas em linguagem natural, interpretar pedidos com base no contexto pessoal e buscar informações em mensagens e outros apps. Assim, o usuário poderá, por exemplo, pedir para tocar uma música recomendada por um amigo em uma conversa ou criar um lembrete relacionado a um compromisso.
O acesso ao contexto pessoal dependerá de um iPhone compatível com a Apple Intelligence, ou seja, a partir do iPhone 15 Pro. A identificação por voz permitirá distinguir os moradores e associar pedidos às informações de cada pessoa.
O primeiro HomePod mini foi anunciado em outubro de 2020. Desde então, a Apple manteve o mesmo hardware, embora tenha ampliado a variedade de cores e lançado atualizações de software. Em 2024, por exemplo, a empresa adicionou a opção meia-noite à linha.
Apesar de aparecer em rumores recentes que apontavam o lançamento do novo irmão menor, a empresa não trouxe uma nova edição do HomePod tradicional, que teve um novo lançamento em 2023.
O lançamento faz parte de uma nova investida da Apple no mercado de casa inteligente, que inclui também a nova Apple TV 4K, o HomeView — um dispositivo com tela para centralizar controles domésticos e recursos da Siri AI — e outros dispositivos da linha Home Collection, em colaboração com a LG.

articles.title: Cerebras CEO pushes back on AI doomsday warnings | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Cerebras Systems CEO and co-founder Andrew Feldman thinks the AI doomer narrative isn’t doing the industry any favors. At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the AI chipmaker exec quipped that “some of the leaders in the AI world maybe shouldn’t be allowed to talk in public.”
He’s referencing the negativity now spreading around the dangers of AI, from models breaking containment to AI insiders debating the percentage chance that AI may kill all of humanity by the end of the decade. The argument has become so mainstream that Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei was recently parodied in a skit on “Saturday Night Live,” where the fictional character summed up the discourse, saying, “We do not condone what we are doing.”
Feldman, however, thinks the promise and potential that go hand in hand with AI developments are getting overlooked. He thinks AI leaders should spend more time telling people that AI could lead to a world where your grandkids will “never meet anybody who dies of cancer,” for instance, even if they have concerns about AI risks.
Clearly, Feldman has a vested interest in AI being successful, as the company’s customers include big names working with the technology, like OpenAI, Block, Figma, pharmaceutical giant GSK, and Lovable.
However, he’s pragmatic about weighing the trade-offs between risk and reward.
“I don’t think there are powerful technologies that don’t come with the challenge of ‘what happens when powerful technologies are in the hands of bad people?’ I think you can’t make one and not have the other,” Feldman said during his interview at Disrupt.
“I think what we have to say is that this technology is powerful,” he added. “We have to be thoughtful about it. We have to regulate it reasonably,” he added.
The chipmaker CEO also suggested that some of the negativity around AI has to do with how the data center industry has approached the new buildouts created by AI demand.
“As an industry, we weren’t super good for the past few years at working with local communities, particularly in the U.S. We — the industry — didn’t do what others have done in the power industry in oil and gas. They didn’t work with the community. They didn’t engage the community as they should have, and that was a problem,” Feldman said.
He compared the NIMBY-ism — “not in my backyard!” — of what’s going on in the U.S. with other countries, naming Brazil, Canada, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Mexico, and Sweden as markets where they’re encouraging companies to build data centers.
Feldman also wasn’t concerned that efficiency improvements would create less demand for his chips, or those from other companies competing with Nvidia, as Cerebras is.
“We can do our job as hardware vendors to make our compute more efficient, and then the model makers can do improved work in making their models more efficient to achieve the same goals. All of this has to come together to make meaningful strides forward,” he noted.

articles.title: I took Leon Kennedy on the go with the Resident Evil 2 remake on Nintendo Switch 2 and this excellent port is the perfect game for spooky season
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The remake of Resident Evil 2 is a survival horror masterpiece, and the Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition runs consistently well on Nintendo Switch 2. With smooth frame rates, solid graphical fidelity, and clean controls, you’re getting the full experience on Nintendo’s hybrid platform with little in the way of sacrifices. It would’ve been neat to see some motion controls included for the Switch 2 release, but this edition is still a fantastic way to play what is arguably the best game in this legendary series.
Reasons to buy
- + Runs smoothly on Switch 2
- + Solid graphical fidelity in both docked and handheld mode
- + Core game is a true survival horror masterpiece
Reasons to avoid
- - Lacks motion or mouse controls
- - Rumble is slightly aggressive in handheld
Why you can trust TechRadar
We spend hours testing every product or service we review, so you can be sure you're buying the best. Find out more about how we test.
The remake of Resident Evil 2 is considered by many to be among the greatest games in Capcom’s legendary survival horror series, and it’s really not hard to see why. Stellar gunplay, immersive environments, a killer cast, and big scares…this entry has it all. And now you can experience it on the go like never before, with the game finally launching on Nintendo Switch 2 in its Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition form.
Platform reviewed: Nintendo Switch 2
Available on: PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch (cloud only), Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and Series S, PC, iOS
Release date: October 16, 2026 (Switch 2 edition)
I’ve played the entirety of Leon and Claire’s stories, dabbled in some extra modes, and tried the title out in both docked and handheld mode.
So, if you’re wondering how the game runs and plays on Nintendo’s latest hybrid system, you’re in the right place. Here’s how I’d rate the Resident Evil 2 remake on Nintendo Switch 2 after more than 20 hours of gameplay.
Experience a legendary remake on the go
While I’m mainly here to talk about Nintendo Switch 2 performance, I’ll get this out of the way first: the Resident Evil 2 remake is survival horror at its finest. This game conjures up a truly daunting atmosphere, with haunting and iconic areas like the Raccoon City Police Station and sewers translating beautifully into a modern, HD format. The gunplay is incredibly smooth and satisfying; you truly have to manage your resources carefully if you want to survive, and everything from random skirmishes through to major boss fights feels phenomenally tense. Pair that with a set of likeable characters, an ambient soundtrack, and rewarding exploration, and you’re looking at a true classic of the genre.
But how well does this top-tier Resident Evil title translate onto Nintendo Switch 2? Very well, thankfully.
First of all, let’s talk performance. While a platform like PS5 Pro may still offer a technically superior experience, I never felt like I was sacrificing much with this Switch 2 version. This version targets 60 frames per second (fps), and my frame rates were delightfully consistent, and gameplay felt smooth, even during higher-octane action segments — when docked or in handheld. Sometimes, the movement of distant enemies seemed a bit choppy, but this never affected my ability to blast them down, and I never realized any similar issues during crucial close combat situations.
It’s a similar story when it comes to visuals too. The game looks solid on Nintendo Switch 2 with HDR support. Dark and gloomy city streets and ambiently lit indoor areas appear detailed and faithful, while character models such as the Tyrant look polished and sharp. As you’d expect, some textures don’t look quite as refined in handheld mode, with elements like Claire’s hair slightly lacking in definition, but the game still looks clear with decent contrast and lighting.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
The moment in which the Tyrant, sometimes known as Mr. X, first appeared in Leon’s path made me jump out of my skin. They made this guy look incredibly daunting (and kinda dapper) for the remake. And I’m even getting chills thinking about the ominous sound of his footsteps as I type this review.
Resident Evil 2 also controls nicely on Nintendo Switch 2, with multiple schemes available through the Options menu. Whether I was using my Turtle Beach Rematch Wireless Controller or playing handheld, it was easy to switch weapons during combat, sprint past zombies, or sort through my inventory. This title also supports HD Rumble, which at times can feel a little overassertive, but overall adds to the immersion nicely. You also get virtual spatial sound, which works brilliantly, especially with headphones.
Something that this title does lack, though, is control schemes that make use of the Switch 2’s unique hardware. For instance, there’s no motion-controlled aiming, which would’ve been a nice touch for those who enjoyed it on Resident Evil Requiem, for instance. There isn’t any mouse mode functionality either, so you’ll be using traditional controls throughout the game. For me, this isn’t a huge problem — I prefer standard right stick aiming, but it would’ve undoubtedly been good to see this game make the most of the Switch 2’s hardware.
When all’s said and done, this is a very competent port of a fantastic survival horror game, and it only helps the Switch 2 establish itself as a major destination for third-party titles as well as big-hit Nintendo releases. Whether you’re new to this series or you’re a long-time fan, this is a great way to experience Resident Evil 2 at home or on the go.
Should you play Resident Evil 2 for Nintendo Switch 2?
Play it if…
You want to take Resident Evil 2 on the go
You get smooth, consistent performance in this edition of Resident Evil 2, even if you’re playing in handheld mode. If you want to enjoy this classic on the go, then Switch 2 should be your go-to destination — there’s no need to play the cloud version on the OG Switch anymore!
You’re new to Resident Evil
Many consider Resident Evil 2 to be a strong starting point for series newcomers, and I’d be inclined to agree. You get to see the origin story of legendary gaming icon Leon Kennedy and the intuitive, modern controls are ideal for the uninitiated. 
Don’t play it if…
You want peak performance
If you want to get the best performance possible, then you still may prefer to play on the PS5 Pro or PC. That being said, the Switch 2 version still looks good, especially docked, and its reliable framerate ensures smooth gameplay at all times.
You’re expecting any major changes
If you’re looking for shiny new content or new ways to play Resident Evil 2, then this version is unlikely to spark your interest. There are no gyro aiming or mouse mode options, and although you’re getting the Deluxe edition here, there’s no brand new content to discover if you own the DLC on other platforms. 
Accessibility features
There are a number of ways to customize your experience in Resident Evil 2, with customizable camera options, three distinct control schemes, toggle or hold run modes, and a wide array of voice and text languages to pick from. In the display section, you can change the color of the reticle, laser dot sight, and dot display, alter HUD opacity, and even turn damage display levels down if you’d prefer.
How I reviewed Resident Evil 2 for Nintendo Switch 2
I spent more than 20 hours with Resident Evil 2 on Nintendo Switch 2, during which time I completed both Leon and Claire’s stories, played some of the extra modes like The Ghost Survivors, and played in both docked and handheld mode.
For the most part, I played the game docked, with my console hooked up to the Sky Glass Gen 2 TV and Marshall Heston 120 soundbar. However, I did indulge in some handheld action here and there, and used my JBL Live Beam 4 earbuds to enjoy virtual spatial sound on the go.
More generally, I’m a seasoned gaming hardware and software reviewer, and have been testing all kinds of games and accessories for years here at TechRadar, where I serve as a Senior Reviews Writer. I’ve reviewed all sorts of games on Nintendo Switch 2, from major first-party releases like Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave to ports of awesome action games, such as Yakuza Kiwami 2.
First reviewed October 2026
Harry is a Senior Reviews Writer for TechRadar. He reviews everything from party speakers to wall chargers and has a particular interest in the worlds of audio and gaming. Harry has a background in business tech journalism, particularly around the telecoms industry.

articles.title: Chinese AI companies buy 1 million Nvidia gaming and workstation GPUs in a single year, report claims — export control-compliant chips flood the market to bridge gap in compute demand
articles.text:
Chinese AI companies buy 1 million Nvidia gaming and workstation GPUs in a single year, report claims — export control-compliant chips flood the market to bridge gap in compute demand
China continues to lean on U.S. chips
Chinese tech companies have bought more than 1 million Nvidia gaming and workstation GPUs to plug gaps in demand for AI computing power, Financial Times reports. The report cites industry insiders who claim the buying spree highlights an ongoing and significant reliance on U.S. AI hardware, despite a burgeoning homegrown market.
The report firstly notes that China's national strategy for developing AI has led to a doubling of domestic AI chip production this year; however, the country cannot keep up with demand from its biggest tech companies. The report cites a shortfall of nearly 1.5 million chips, with only 3.5 million expected to be manufactured domestically while demand "far exceeds" 5 million. To compensate, China is purportedly turning to Nvidia's gaming and workstation processors, which are compliant with U.S. export controls, repurposing them for AI.
According to FT, the chips are "mostly" Nvidia's RTX Pro 6000D, RTX Pro 5000, and the RTX 5090, the latter of which is the best graphics card on the market for enthusiast gaming. As the report notes, these Blackwell chips can't compete with Huawei's Ascend 910C and other homegrown flagship offerings, but they are useful for "simpler AI workloads," such as prefilling.
This is significant pressure on a GPU market where prices for enthusiast cards have already skyrocketed. The RTX 5090's MSRP is $1,999; however, the card can now only be found at a handful (three) of third-party resellers for no less than $7,199, and has all but disappeared from the market.
The report highlights that demand for Nvidia's GPUs is driven in part by its CUDA software, which remains more favorable than Huawei's Cann alternative.
As for the enthusiast market, it was recently reported that Nvidia has halted RTX 5090 production, to be replaced by a 24GB RTX 5080 flagship. That would mark a significant step down from the 32GB the 5090 currently boasts, a troubling sign for enthusiasts that the enthusiast gaming GPU market appears to be receding, rather than advancing.

articles.title: Praktische Updates für Google Wallet: Mit diesen Neuerungen sparst du jetzt Zeit
articles.text:
4 neue Funktionen für Google Wallet: Wie Nutzer im Alltag davon profitieren
Für Android-User:innen, die mobil bezahlen und nicht jede Kreditkarte immer physisch mit sich herumtragen wollen, ist Google Wallet oftmals die erste Anlaufstelle. Schließlich ist die Bezahl- und Karten-App auf den Geräten vorinstalliert und beherbergt einige nützliche Features. Jetzt erweitert Google den Funktionsumfang der Wallet-App noch um vier weitere Features, wie das Unternehmen in den Oktober-Patchnotes des Google-Play-Service-Updates verrät.
Google Wallet: Quittungen und Benachrichtigungen immer im Blick
Zunächst heißt es in dem Beitrag, dass User:innen künftig Quittungen und Belege einfacher in der Google Wallet einfügen können. Zuvor mussten die Beträge und Posten darauf händisch eingetragen werden. Nach dem Update können Nutzer:innen die Belege einfach in der App einscannen und die Google Wallet übernimmt alle wichtigen Einträge selbstständig.
Die zweite Neuerung betrifft Googles Bezahldienst Pay, wenn du ihn in Chrome nutzt. Dort lässt sich jetzt bei einem Kauf die Seite für die Zahlungsbestätigung überspringen, sofern du dem Onlineshop schon Daten wie deinen Namen, deine E‑Mail-Adresse und deine Telefonnummer mitgeteilt hast. Dadurch soll der Checkout über Google Pay beschleunigt werden.
Ebenfalls praktisch: Mit dem Update werden die Benachrichtigungen in gleich zwei Bereichen verbessert. Zum einen bekommt die Google Wallet ein eigenes „In-App Message Center“, wie Google schreibt. Dort lassen sich dann wohl sämtliche Zahlungsaktivitäten sowie eingespeicherte Karten und Tickets in einem chronologischen Verlauf nachvollziehen.
Zum anderen verbessert Google die Händlerbezeichnungen, die in den Benachrichtigungen zu Transaktionen auftauchen. Dadurch sollst du nicht mehr auf kryptische Bezeichnungen stoßen, sondern immer gleich wissen, wer hinter der Transaktion steckt. Wann die Neuerungen für die Google Wallet ausrollen und ob alle User:innen gleichzeitig damit versorgt werden, ist nicht bekannt. Der Rollout sollte aber spätestens im Verlauf des Oktobers 2026 abgeschlossen sein.

articles.title: New Apple product: The Apple HomeView
articles.text:
Apple has announced a range of new smart home devices and a partnership with LG and Schneider Electric. Of the new smart home products, the most intriguing is the Apple HomeView, a smart home speaker with an attached display.
I realized I was so interested in the HomeView that I stopped taking notes and just listened and asked questions during the presentation. So I’m excited to dive in:
Introducing the Apple HomeView
View this post on Instagram
The Apple HomeView sports a 7-inch Liquid Retina smart display and comes in Space Grey, Silver, Starlight and Rose Pink. However, you can also get a wall-mounted version in Space Grey and Silver.
The smart display will intelligently adapt to each person. For instance, when I approach the HomeView, it’ll unlock with my face — it’s not the same technology as Face ID, but I’ll dive into that later.
After you unlock the display, you’ll see your home screen, where you can access apps like Apple Music, FaceTime, Messages, Safari, and Apple TV. You can resume the show you were watching on Apple TV, listen to your playlists on Apple Music, and reply to text messages. But when you walk away, HomeView locks itself, preventing your partner or kids from accessing your Messages. Next time it unlocks, it’ll open to their own home screen, which might look completely different from yours, with different widgets and apps.
Because the device itself doesn’t use the same hardware as Face ID on your iPad or iPhone, Apple has taken extra measures to keep it secure. This includes being on the Home account, specifically registering your face/voice with HomeView, having your smartphone connected to the same Wi-Fi or recently in the same location, and having recently unlocked it. If HomeView isn’t sure it’s you, it’ll ask you to unlock your handset to verify.
While I haven’t had hands-on time with the device, I saw a few demos, and they looked pretty cool. For instance, I saw how the HomeView handles recipes. So if you have your HomeView in the kitchen (though it doesn’t need to be in the kitchen for this) and you pull up a recipe, it shows two tabs: one for ingredients and one for directions. It even shows how long each step will take, and you can set a timer with Siri or with a tap. After this, the demoer asked Siri what time the Tribeca market opens, then asked Siri to add berries to her shopping list and remind her to grab bags 10 minutes before the market opens. Afterward, Siri showed a visual confirmation that it added this to her reminders, indicating it worked without a hitch.
We saw another demo where you can ask HomeView to play a song shared by a friend. The user said, “Siri, play that song Dave sent me.” It immediately went over to Apple Music and started playing a Bad Bunny song. You could also show the lyrics for a karaoke night, or show the animated album art that looked great on the 7-inch display.
Of course, it has room-filling audio (literally, it presented this in an open-concept room with two kitchen sections and a living room in between), two drivers, and four mics, including far-field mics that can pick up your voice from farther away. Like the Apple Watch, the HomeView has tons of faces you can show when you’re not using it. You can set different widgets, colours, and styles like an Apple Watch; pick your favourite photos, or even choose an animated Snoopy one that reacts to the weather and holidays.
The wall-mounted variant loses two speakers, but Apple says it still delivers great sound by using technology that takes advantage of the wall. You’re able to wall-mount it yourself, but you’ll see the hanging wire. There are two other ways of wall-mounting the device to hide the power cord, but Apple suggests you leave it up to the professionals.
The HomeView is only compatible with iOS 27.2 (so you might need an update).
I’ve reviewed smart home products before, but this was literally the first time I considered pre-ordering a smart home device for myself. Speaking of pre-orders, they open today, and the HomeView officially releases on November 13. The Apple HomeView costs C$429.

articles.title: Microsoft: Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro reached end of support
articles.text:
Microsoft announced today that devices running Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro editions have reached the end of support and will no longer receive monthly security and non-security preview updates.
However, according to Microsoft's lifecycle policy, Windows 11 24H2 Enterprise and Education editions remain under mainstream support until October 12, 2027.
"Today, October 13, 2026, Windows 11, version 24H2 Home and Pro, and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016 have reached end of updates. The October 2026 monthly security update is the last update available for these editions," Microsoft said in a message center update.
"Devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security and non-security preview updates containing protections from the latest security threats."
Microsoft advises users to upgrade to Windows 11 26H2, the latest Windows 11 version, also known as the Windows 11 2026 Update, which is now rolling out in phases to eligible Windows 11 devices where the "Get the latest updates as soon as they're available" option has been enabled.
Windows 11 26H2 became generally available in September 2026 as an enablement package and will reach end of support for consumers in October 2029.
"Windows 11, version 26H2 rollout is phased and will expand over the next few months," it added. "If the update is ready for your device, it will download and install automatically, and a single restart will complete the process."
Last week, Microsoft also reminded customers that systems running Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise, Education, and IoT Enterprise editions will also stop receiving security updates in 30 days, after Windows 11 23H2 Home and Pro editions reach end of support in November 2025.
Earlier this year, it extended the free Windows 10 Extended Security Updates (ESU) program for home users and announced that Windows Server 2022 also reaches the end of mainstream support today (but will remain under extended support until October 2031).
More recently, on Thursday, it warned customers to upgrade devices running unsupported versions of Windows as they will stop receiving security updates after next year's Windows Update certificate rotation.
More information about Windows 11 servicing dates is available on the Windows Lifecycle FAQ page or using the Lifecycle Policy search tool.

articles.title: Broadcom adds hypervisor protection to VMware - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Broadcom adds hypervisor protection to VMware
Citing the growing speed and volume of artificial intelligence-enabled attacks, Broadcom Inc. today introduced VMware HyperArmor, software that protects the hypervisor underlying VMware Cloud Foundation and gives administrators more time to test and deploy security patches.
Announced at VMware Explore in Frankfurt, HyperArmor targets two common routes into virtualized infrastructure: stolen root credentials and unpatched vulnerabilities. It combines host-level virtual patching, controls on executable programs and scripts and multifactor authentication for remote access to VMware ESX hosts.
Broadcom executives said the product responds to attacks that are accelerating faster than enterprises can update infrastructure software.
“You don’t have enough time to triage a single alert, and you can’t apply patches at machine speed,” said Prashanth Shenoy, chief marketing officer and vice president of marketing for cloud platform, infrastructure and solutions at Broadcom.
HyperArmor operates directly at the ESX layer, which runs directly on a physical server to support virtual machines. Protecting the hypervisor is important because it undergirds all workloads that depend on that host.
The virtual patching capability is designed to detect and block malicious actions without modifying the underlying infrastructure software. Broadcom said it requires neither host reboots nor software upgrades to mitigate vulnerabilities, allowing infrastructure teams to schedule testing and installation of official patches.
Eric Chien, a Broadcom distinguished engineer who was involved in building HyperArmor, emphasized that the protection gives administrators breathing room rather than eliminating the need to update their systems.
“We always still want you to patch; that is the right thing to do, but this basically buys you time,” Chien said. He added that customers face a steady flow of patches across their environments and want help reducing the pressure to deploy each update immediately.
HyperArmor also establishes a baseline of permitted activity on ESX hosts, which run a relatively small, fixed collection of processes. It inventories existing scripts and runs them automatically, requiring administrators to approve new scripts. Unauthorized executables and scripts are blocked by default.
That approach differs from security tools protecting general-purpose applications, Chien said. Because Broadcom knows which processes should run on the hypervisor, it can enforce restrictions directly within the host rather than relying solely on network inspection.
Minimal overhead
Broadcom said the product continuously monitors host processes and behavior with minimal performance overhead. It doesn’t require security agents inside individual guest virtual machines.
The third component integrates multifactor authentication into the ESX Secure Shell login process. Users must provide standard SSH credentials and then complete a time-based one-time password challenge tied to a separate identity. Broadcom said that prevents someone who obtains a root password from reaching the command line without the second factor.
HyperArmor complements VMware vDefend, which provides security at the network and workload level. That includes microsegmentation, traffic inspection and network-level virtual patching. VMware Avi Load Balancer protects web applications and application programming interfaces.
“HyperArmor is at the ESX host layer,” Shenoy said. “VDefend acts at the network and workload layer, along with the Avi web application firewall.”
Cloud Foundation already includes centralized identity management, encryption and live patching that applies critical hypervisor updates without taking workloads offline or putting hosts into maintenance mode. HyperArmor adds controls intended to protect the host while administrators prepare software patches.
Chien said the product emerged from conversations with customers attempting to build their own hypervisor protections and struggling to sustain the effort.
HyperArmor supports ESX 8.x and later releases, extending protection to customers preparing upgrades to newer VMware platforms. Customers can purchase it directly from Broadcom or through its partners and resellers, using the same sales channels available for VMware Cloud Foundation. Pricing wasn’t disclosed.

articles.title: « Oui, c’est une bonne idée ! » Comment Citroën a gardé la surprise de la 2 CV Fourgonnette - Numerama
articles.text:
Il n’est pas toujours évident de garder les secrets bien longtemps dans l’industrie automobile. Les fuites sont légion, mais Citroën tenait à réserver une vraie surprise pour l’édition 2026 du Mondial de l’Automobile de Paris, qui se tient du 12 au 18 octobre.
Si toute l’attention était concentrée sur le lancement du concept 2 CV, la marque avait pourtant promis un second concept sans rien en dévoiler. C’est plutôt rare. Rien ne laissait présager cette version utilitaire, d’autant que Xavier Chardon, le patron de la marque, avait habilement fait mine de ne pas y avoir pensé lors d’une table ronde à laquelle nous avions assisté quelques jours plus tôt. Un beau coup de bluff, qu’on lui pardonne volontiers.
L’utilitaire de Citroën qui refuse la banalité
Dévoilée aux côtés de la citadine, cette 2 CV Fourgonnette Concept reprend logiquement les fondamentaux de la nouvelle « Deuche » : une motorisation électrique, une conception centrée sur l’essentiel et une approche très pragmatique. L’objectif des designers ? Faire revivre l’esprit de cet utilitaire mythique qui a accompagné des générations d’artisans, de commerçants et de livreurs, mais avec les codes de la mobilité d’aujourd’hui.
« La 2 CV Fourgonnette n’était pas seulement un outil de travail. Elle faisait partie de la vie. Simple, ingénieuse, accessible, elle avait surtout quelque chose que peu d’utilitaires ont : une âme », explique Xavier Chardon dans le communiqué de presse. « Parce qu’utile ne devrait jamais vouloir dire banal. » Le patron de Citroën marque des points avec cette déclaration.
Ce projet est d’ailleurs décrit par la marque comme un véritable « projet de cœur » et un pur exercice de style imaginé librement par les designers. Contrairement à la version grand public (dont l’ambition est d’arriver sur nos routes d’ici à 2028 autour de 15 000 euros), Citroën précise que cette fourgonnette ne préfigure pas un modèle de série à court terme. Ce serait pourtant probablement une erreur de ne pas envisager sa commercialisation.
La vraie bonne surprise du Mondial de l’Auto
Au vu des réactions très enthousiastes sur le salon, aussi bien de la part des médias que des concurrents et des premiers visiteurs, la marque aux chevrons aurait sans doute tort de cantonner ce concept au rang de simple étude. C’est l’une des bonnes surprises de ce Mondial de l’Auto. Là où beaucoup de fourgons électriques actuels privilégient un design clinique, cubique et rationnel, cette 2 CV Fourgonnette apporte un supplément d’âme à l’univers professionnel. C’est le genre de véhicule qui donne le sourire.
Son allure attachante et ses clins d’œil au passé font mouche instantanément. En cachant son jeu jusqu’à la dernière minute, Citroën a signé un joli coup de communication. On passera même l’éponge sur le fait que Xavier Chardon, quelques jours auparavant, a feint la surprise quand il a été interrogé sur cette éventualité. « Ah oui, c’est une bonne idée ! », avaient répondu d’une même voix les différents acteurs du projet (dont le patron de la marque), comme si l’idée ne les avait pas effleurés. Ce n’était qu’un petit mensonge innocent pour préserver la surprise, mais Xavier Chardon l’a prononcé les yeux dans les yeux devant un panel de journalistes.
Et si Citroën affirme qu’il ne s’agit pour l’instant que d’une piste de réflexion destinée à « ouvrir le débat », l’engouement suscité par cette bouille néo-rétro pourrait bien pousser Stellantis à envisager une production au-delà de 2028. Après tout, les artisans aussi ont le droit de rouler avec le sourire.

articles.title: Jouer aux jeux Xbox sur PS5 ? Un développeur a réussi l'impensable grâce à l'IA
articles.text:
Un développeur brésilien a conçu PSBox Cloud Gaming, un client qui fait tourner Xbox Cloud Gaming nativement sur une PS5 débridée. Streaming en 1080p60, upscaling 4K et manettes DualSense reconnues comme des manettes Xbox.
On n'y aurait jamais cru mais jouer aux jeux Xbox sur PS5 est désormais possible, à condition de disposer d’une console jailbreakée. Le développeur RafaelNGP a conçu son client en s’appuyant en partie sur l'IA avec Claude. Le service de streaming de Microsoft, jamais proposé officiellement sur la console de Sony, s’y lance comme une application, avec le catalogue cloud accessible depuis le salon.
Un simple fichier zip et une connexion depuis un smartphone
L’installation tient en quelques gestes : télécharger l’archive .zip sur GitHub, l’extraire dans un dossier précis puis le charger avec un loader homebrew. La connexion à son compte se fait ensuite depuis le smartphone, grâce à un code affiché sur la télévision. Tout cela suppose une PS5 déjà jailbreakée, ce qui exclut les consoles standards.
Le client diffuse en 1080p60, pour viser la 4K, il s’appuie sur le GPU de la PS5 avec deux upscalers au choix : le FSR 1 d’AMD ou Anime4K. Il ajoute un menu en jeu (statistiques, options d’image, résolution du flux), le clavier système pour les champs de texte et la prise en charge de jusqu’à quatre manettes DualSense, vues comme des manettes Xbox par l’application.
Des artefacts vidéo et une fonction Remote Play ajoutée en quelques jours
Le client n’est pas exempt de défauts. Des testeurs signalent du macroblocking, des artefacts roses et des problèmes de vibration sur les DualSense, tandis que d’autres se disent ravis de l’expérience.
Le développeur a aussi vite réagi à une demande de la communauté. Un commentaire sur Reddit réclamait le Xbox Remote Play, c’est-à-dire le streaming depuis une Xbox déjà possédée vers la PS5. Le créateur du logiciel a publié quelques jours plus tard une mise à jour qui l’active.
L’ironie du calendrier pour Microsoft
Le timing a de quoi faire sourire. Deux ans après la campagne « This is an Xbox » et l’arrivée d’anciennes exclusivités Xbox sur PS5, Microsoft a changé de cap sous la direction d’Asha Sharma. Pourtant, une brique du Game Pass, le cloud gaming, s’invite bien sur la console de Sony, de façon non officielle. En revanche, les nouvelles limites de temps de jeu vont toucher tous les paliers de l’abonnement le mois prochain, ce qui rendra le cloud gaming moins attractif.
Ce client s’ajoute à d’autres exploits du homebrew PS5, dont l’émulation native de la PS3 et celle de la Xbox originale. Des réactions attendues à certaines décisions contestées de Sony, comme l’arrêt de la production de disques en 2028, tout en jugeant improbable que ces projets, cantonnés à des consoles jailbreakées, fassent changer la firme d’avis.

articles.title: Agentic video startup Clueso raises $10 million in Series A
articles.text:
Agentic video startup Clueso raises $10M in Series A funding round
The startup founded by IIT Madras alumni plans to use the funding to scale its enterprise go-to-market reach, deepen its agentic layer, and expand editing capabilities.
Clueso, the agentic video platform for business founded by IIT Madras alumni, has raised $10 million in a Series A round of funding led by Dharana Capital, with Founders Future and Neotribe Ventures joining as new investors.
The round also saw participation from Y Combinator and f7 Ventures. This round brings the total fund raised to $12 million.
Founded in 2023 by Akash Anand, Prajwal Prakash, and Neel Balar, Clueso is based out of California and Bengaluru. It plans to use the funding to scale its enterprise go-to-market reach, deepen its agentic layer, and expand editing capabilities.
The startup says more than 1,000 companies use its platform to create videos for functions such as marketing, customer success and education, onboarding and training. Customers include Atlassian, Zendesk, Gainsight, GlobalPartners, Seismic, and Ironclad. Clueso claims that users have reported productivity gains of over 5x and an 80% reduction in video production costs.
Clueso's co-founder & CEO Akash Anand noted that the company started out by helping customer-facing teams create product tutorials faster. “We quickly saw the same problem across marketing, sales, training and internal documentation. That made us realise the opportunity was much bigger. Today, Clueso acts as an AI video production team that anyone or any team in the organisation can rely on, handling the work of creating, editing and maintaining videos as the business moves.”
Clueso is building AI agents that understand a company’s products, processes, brand and context, and then use that knowledge to create and maintain video across the organisation.
Vamsi Duvvuri, Founder and Managing Partner at Dharana Capital said, “With AI, video is evolving from static media files into living, context-aware assets that continuously adapt as business processes and products change. Clueso is building the infrastructure powering this shift.”
Edited by Swetha Kannan

articles.title: En Brasil tienen un atajo para resolver la vivienda: 2 toneladas de plástico, 27 metros cuadrados y montaje en 15 horas
articles.text:
Rejane Alves de Souza es madre de nueve hijos y abuela de doce nietos. Tiene 45 años, y en 2023 recibió las llaves de una casa que no se parece a la mayoría de los hogares en Brasil, pues sus paredes están hechas de bloques de plástico reciclado. La casa, situada en Porto de Areia, una comunidad en Carapicuíba, en el estado de São Paulo, fue construida en tan solo 15 horas.
Sin chabolas y sin residuos plásticos. La casa fue un proyecto piloto de la ONG TETO Brasil y sus socios la presentaron como la primera de 1.000 viviendas que esperan construir con el mismo método, según contaba por aquel entonces la organización. La idea es que cada una mantenga alrededor de dos toneladas de residuos plásticos fuera del medio ambiente, al tiempo que sustituye las chabolas de lona y madera en las que viven muchas familias. De esta forma se estarían matando dos pájaros de un tiro: abordar el problema del nefasto estado de muchas de las viviendas de chabolas de brasil y la contaminación por plástico.
Los detalles. La unidad es una vivienda de 27 metros cuadrados con espacio para tres estancias, incluido un baño, además de sistemas eléctricos y de fontanería. TETO la describe como la versión más sostenible de su proyecto "Vivienda Semilla", lanzado a principios de 2023.
La empresa Fuplastic desarrolló los bloques de plástico, que encajan como piezas de Lego sin necesidad de mortero. Por otro lado, el tejado está hecho con cartones reciclados de leche, zumo y pasta de dientes. La casa cuenta además con paneles solares y un sistema de recogida de agua de lluvia. Junto a ello, la ONG Biosanitation instaló un sistema de tratamiento de aguas residuales con un biodigestor y una zanja de infiltración. Por último, Amanco Wavin se encargó de las tuberías y conductos, y sus empleados colaboraron como voluntarios durante la instalación.
Quién recibió las llaves. Tal y como cuentan desde la ONG, Rejane perdió su empleo tras desarrollar artrosis en la parte baja de la espalda, lo que la empujó a mudarse a Porto de Areia. También había superado un cáncer, y TETO afirmó que el nuevo hogar le daría más estabilidad para cuidar de su salud y la de su hijo menor. Según la organización, el niño había sufrido acoso escolar por vivir en la chabola más precaria de la comunidad. Rejane ayudó con la construcción.
El director de TETO en São Paulo, Lucas Borges, contó en su momento que las favelas se encuentran entre los lugares más expuestos a la crisis climática, incluidas las inundaciones y las lluvias intensas. De ahí que la casa pretenda ser una respuesta a ambos problemas.
Cómo funcionan los bloques. El director ejecutivo de Fuplastic, Bruno Frederico, arquitecto, contaba al medio brasileño Abecip que los bloques se fabrican inyectando polietileno reciclado en moldes. Según él, el plástico procede de cooperativas de reciclaje y el precio final es similar al de los ladrillos ordinarios. Estima que cada 50 metros cuadrados de construcción retira del medio ambiente unas 2,5 toneladas de plástico. También afirma que los bloques son huecos, lo que permite circular el aire y ayuda a mantener las casas más frescas que el ladrillo de arcilla.
El diseño modular se adapta a espacios reducidos. Y es que la casa se puede montar en forma de L, de vagón o en disposición cuadrada, por lo que se adapta a los solares estrechos típicos de las favelas. Además, como la estructura se puede desmontar sin producir escombros, los bloques se pueden reutilizar o reciclar de nuevo.
Hasta dónde alcanza. En 2024, un modelo de 54 metros cuadrados hecho con 4.900 bloques se exhibió en el centro de São Paulo durante el festival Cidade do Futuro. Según cuenta Abecip, se montó y desmontó en pocas horas y se podía revestir con paneles de yeso para que pareciera una pared convencional. Frederico afirmó que Fuplastic también había propuesto una asociación con la agencia de vivienda de São Paulo, CDHU, para utilizar la tecnología en viviendas sociales permanentes.

articles.title: Doctolib, Pigment, Genesis AI, Entalpic : Nvidia fait ses courses en France et investit dans l'IA — Frandroid
articles.text:
De passage à Paris ce mardi 13 octobre, Jensen Huang, CEO de Nvidia, a annoncé que son groupe devenait actionnaire minoritaire de Doctolib.
En plus d’entrer au capital, pour un montant tenu secret, le leader mondial des puces pour l’IA va aider la plateforme de rendez-vous médicaux à entraîner ses propres modèles d’IA en Europe. Le partenariat doit notamment accélérer l’assistant IA que Doctolib destine aux patients, déjà utilisé par 400 000 Français et promis à tous en 2027.
Nvidia est valorisé 5 433 milliards de dollars en Bourse (environ 4 860 milliards d’euros), soit à peu près 1 350 fois la dernière valorisation connue de Doctolib. Ni la part du capital achetée ni la valorisation retenue pour l’opération n’ont été rendues publiques.
Jusqu’à 330€ d’avantages avec nos offres Hello Prime ou Hello Prime Duo, dont 80€ cash à l’ouverture de compte !
L’entreprise française connaît déjà la maison, puisqu’elle utilise les technologies de Nvidia depuis un an. Entraîner un modèle d’IA consiste à lui faire avaler d’énormes volumes de données pour qu’il apprenne à répondre.
Dans un message publié ce mardi, Doctolib dit vouloir recruter plus vite dans l’IA grâce à ce partenariat. L’entreprise prévoit aussi des assistants d’aide à la décision clinique, conçus avec des soignants et des hôpitaux européens.
La souveraineté passe par les puces de Nvidia
Doctolib fait partie d’un lot de quatre. Nvidia investit aussi dans Pigment, qui édite un logiciel de planification pour les entreprises, dans Genesis AI, qui développe des robots à tout faire, et dans Entalpic, qui conçoit des matériaux à l’échelle atomique pour l’industrie des semi-conducteurs. Jensen Huang veut ainsi, selon ses mots, « lancer la révolution de l’intelligence artificielle en Europe » (rien que ça).
Le patron de Nvidia a aussi promis d’annoncer 2 milliards de dollars d’investissements européens d’ici une semaine (environ 1,8 milliard d’euros). Ils s’ajoutent aux 8 milliards de dollars (environ 7,2 milliards d’euros) placés sur le continent depuis un an. Sa tournée passe ensuite par Londres et Berlin.
Le discours officiel parle de souveraineté, avec des modèles entraînés en Europe. Sauf que ces modèles tournent sur des puces Nvidia, et que l’investisseur est aussi le fournisseur.
Nvidia applique déjà cette recette ailleurs, en investissant 30 milliards de dollars dans OpenAI, son meilleur client pour les GPU (environ 27 milliards d’euros). Il a aussi racheté Hugging Face pour 12,9 milliards de dollars (environ 11,5 milliards d’euros), la plateforme où se partagent les modèles d’IA ouverts.
Les prochains investissements européens de Nvidia devraient être dévoilés d’ici la conférence GTC de Berlin, que Jensen Huang ouvrira le 21 octobre.

articles.title: Le HomeView est là : Apple sort un écran connecté dopé à l'IA (mais vous savez où se trouve le hic)
articles.text:
Le HomeView est là : Apple sort un écran connecté dopé à l'IA (mais vous savez où se trouve le hic)
Apple dévoile son premier écran connecté, le HomeView. Doté d'une dalle de 7 pouces et pensé pour accueillir Siri, ce hub domotique reste pour l'heure exclusif au marché étasunien.
On l'attendait sous le nom de HomePad, et il s'appelle finalement HomeView. Le premier écran connecté d'Apple, pensé comme un hub domotique, fait sa première apparition officielle avec un design qui n'est pas sans rappeler les iMac sortis au tournant du siècle. Conçu pour héberger Siri AI, l'assistant personnel d'Apple dopé à l'intelligence artificielle, l'appareil se place en concurrence directe avec le Nest Hub de seconde génération commercialisé par Google.
Écran et design : une dalle Liquid Retina carrée de 7 pouces pour la maison
Cet écran connecté s'offre une dalle de 7 pouces reposant sur la technologie Liquid Retina (soit un panneau led de 1088 x 1088 pixels) et promettant une luminosité maximale de 500 cd/m². C'est modeste, mais un tel équipement n'étant pas voué à sortir du domicile, cela reste amplement suffisant.
Pour faciliter son intégration sur une table de chevet, Cupertino annonce par ailleurs une luminosité minimale de 0,3 cd/m² ; autant dire qu'il ne devrait pas perturber le sommeil. Apple a ainsi opté pour un afficheur au format carré inséré dans un boîtier de 14,5 cm de côté. Il ne faut pas entièrement se fier aux rendus du site officiel, le HomeView est plus compact qu'il n'y paraît.
Fonctionnalités et Siri AI : pourquoi le HomeView est privé d'Europe
Que faire avec un tel appareil ? D'abord, formuler des requêtes vocales à l'aide de Siri AI, ce qui signale d'emblée que le HomeView boude l'Union européenne. L’assistant est en effet limité aux Mac et à Vision OS, et reste indisponible sur les iPhone et iPad en raison du Digital Markets Act. En plein bras de fer avec l'Union européenne pour y faire accepter son nouveau Siri, Apple choisit donc de réserver son HomeView au marché nord-américain.
Revenons-en aux fonctionnalités de l’appareil… En plus de répondre aux requêtes formulées auprès de Siri AI, il fait office d'outil de visioconférence (sa caméra Center Stage de 12 Mpx est dédiée à FaceTime), de mini-enceinte compatible avec l'Audio spatial et les configurations AirPlay multiroom, ainsi que de capteur de température et d'humidité. Le boîtier est animé par la puce A18 inaugurée sur les iPhone 16, et prend en charge le wifi 6E, ainsi que le Bluetooth 6.0.
Prix et disponibilité du nouvel écran connecté Apple
Proposé sous la forme d'un écran à fixer au mur ou d'une mini-tablette posée sur son support-enceinte, le HomeView est annoncé au tarif de 299 $. Il est d'ores et déjà disponible en précommande aux États-Unis et sera livré à compter du 13 novembre 2026.

articles.title: Apple TV 4K con Siri AI: fecha de lanzamiento y sus características
articles.text:
Apple presentó una nueva generación del Apple TV 4K, su dispositivo para ver contenido en streaming y controlar accesorios del hogar inteligente. La principal novedad es Siri AI, una versión más conversacional del asistente que permite buscar películas y series, hacer preguntas sobre lo que se está viendo y manejar dispositivos compatibles mediante la voz.
Las reservas comenzaron el martes 13 de octubre en la tienda en línea y la aplicación Apple Store. El dispositivo llegará a las tiendas y empezará a entregarse el viernes 13 de noviembre, según el anuncio oficial de Apple. La compañía fijó su precio en 299 dólares en Estados Unidos.
Siri AI permite buscar contenido y hacer preguntas
Siri AI aparece en una interfaz a pantalla completa y permite buscar contenido con preguntas conversacionales. Por ejemplo, el usuario puede pedir recomendaciones de comedias premiadas y recibir sugerencias con imágenes tomadas directamente de la aplicación Apple TV.
El asistente también responderá preguntas mientras se reproduce una película o una serie. Se le podrá consultar dónde se filmó una escena o si un programa es adecuado para una persona de determinada edad. Las respuestas aparecerán en una ventana compacta para no cubrir toda la pantalla ni detener la reproducción.
Apple señala que Siri AI puede aprovechar el contexto personal de un iPhone compatible con Apple Intelligence. De ese modo, el usuario podrá pedirle que reproduzca una serie recomendada por uno de sus contactos. La disponibilidad inicial de Siri AI estará limitada a ciertos países e idiomas; Apple anunció que llegará en inglés a Estados Unidos, Australia, Canadá, India, Nueva Zelanda, Singapur, Sudáfrica y Reino Unido.
Chip A19 y control por voz sin el mando
El nuevo Apple TV 4K utiliza el chip A19. Según Apple, ofrece hasta un 50 % más de rendimiento de CPU y el doble de rendimiento gráfico frente a la generación anterior. El procesador también incluye un decodificador AV1, tecnología que permite reproducir contenido en streaming con mayor eficiencia y un menor consumo de ancho de banda.
El equipo incorpora tres micrófonos de campo lejano para controlar la reproducción y buscar contenido sin tener que sostener el Siri Remote. Apple indica que la cancelación de eco ayuda a que el dispositivo reconozca la voz incluso cuando el televisor está reproduciendo audio.
El Siri Remote conserva su diseño, pero ahora es compatible con la red Buscar de Apple. Desde un iPhone se podrá localizar el mando con indicaciones de precisión o activar un sonido para encontrarlo.
Sonido envolvente con cuatro HomePod
Por primera vez, el Apple TV 4K podrá utilizarse con cuatro altavoces HomePod para crear un sistema de sonido envolvente. La configuración es compatible con cuatro HomePod mini 2 o cuatro HomePod de segunda generación. También se pueden combinar ambos modelos, siempre que los altavoces delanteros sean iguales entre sí y los traseros también formen un par del mismo modelo.
El sistema detecta la ubicación de los altavoces y ajusta los niveles y tiempos del audio según la distribución de la sala. Apple lo presenta como su experiencia de sonido envolvente más inmersiva hasta la fecha.
Funciones para el hogar
El dispositivo mantiene su función de centro del hogar inteligente: permite controlar accesorios y automatizaciones, y recibir en el televisor notificaciones de timbres compatibles. Con Apple Intelligence, la aplicación Hogar sumará descripciones de la actividad detectada por cámaras y resúmenes de notificaciones.

articles.title: ESA targets Anbernic emulation handhelds as "superfake" piracy enablers
articles.text:
For years, Chinese hardware manufacturers have carved out a market niche with an array of handheld Android gaming devices focused on retro emulation and/or more modern game-streaming capabilities. Now, though, a major game industry trade group is targeting one of those manufacturers, Anbernic, asking the US Trade Representative (USTR) to add the company to its list of “Notorious Markets” that “engage in or facilitate substantial copyright piracy or trademark counterfeiting.”
TorrentFreak was among the first to notice the request from the Entertainment Software Association (ESA), which was submitted to the USTR last week. In it, the US trade group—which represents major publishers including Nintendo, Microsoft, PlayStation, Amazon, Epic, EA, Ubisoft, and more—notes that Anbernic devices “are routinely offered or shipped with removable memory cards preloaded with hundreds or thousands of unauthorized copies of copyright-protected video games published by ESA members.”
While many online sellers do include an SD card full of ROMs alongside emulation hardware of all types, Anbernic itself does not appear to do the same when selling directly from its website. Regardless, the ESA argues that these ROM-laden Anbernic devices selling through “normal retail channels” help to “normalize hardware-based piracy by delivering illicit catalogues through a polished consumer product.” This, the ESA says, meets the threshold for a “superfake,” an ill-defined designation that applies to “high-quality counterfeit trademark goods … on a commercial scale.”
Being included on the USTR’s Notorious Market List wouldn’t bring any additional direct legal consequences for a company like Anbernic. However, the USTR says the list “encourages the responsible authorities to step up efforts to combat piracy and counterfeiting” and notes that the list itself “increase[s] public awareness and help market operators and governments prioritize intellectual property enforcement efforts that protect American businesses and their workers.” Inclusion on the list could also presage a Section 301 investigation that could lead to legal consequences or restrictive import controls on the devices.
@Kyle Orland I think you should have read a bit further in the reddit comments you linked to:
View: https://www.reddit.com/r/Handhelds/comments/1x4u2zp/comment/pghpclh/
I have ordered direct from anbernic, and that second SD card most definitely came chock full of ROMs.

articles.title: Motorola Edge 60 (512 GB) tem 12 GB de RAM e cai 46% com cupom • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Motorola Edge 60 (512 GB) tem 12 GB de RAM e cai 46% com cupom
Edge 60 (512 GB) traz 12 GB de RAM e câmeras de 50 MP; celular da Motorola sai por quase metade do preço original, no Pix com cupom no Mercado Livre
O Edge 60 de 512 GB está saindo por R$ 1.895 no Pix com cupom MELHORDEHJ no Mercado Livre. O celular da Motorola, com 12 GB de RAM e câmeras de 50 MP, recebe desconto de 46% sobre o preço original de R$ 3.499.
Embora não seja o menor preço histórico, esta é uma ótima oferta de um celular básico, com bastante RAM física para rodar apps e games.
O Edge 60 é um intermediário equipado com 12 GB de RAM física e o chip MediaTek Dimensity 7300, que sustentam apps em multitarefa e alguns recursos do Moto AI. Os 512 GB de armazenamento oferecem espaço interno de sobra para quem adora filmar e fotografar.
Falando nisso, seu kit de câmeras traz uma wide com OIS e uma ultrawide de 122º, que captam belas situações com grandes ângulos, e uma frontal que tira ótimas selfies, todas de 50 MP. A telefoto de 10 MP traz zoom óptico de 3x para aproximações com muitos detalhes. Todas filmam em 4K.
A tela POLED de 6,7″, com taxa de 120 Hz e brilho de 4.500 nits, é capaz de reproduzir imagens com cores fiéis e alta fluidez nas transições em apps e games, além de garantir a visibilidade em qualquer lugar. O vidro Gorilla Glass 7i protege o display contra pancadas e arranhões.
O corpo do Edge 60 recebe as certificações IP68/IP69 e militar MIL-STD-810H, que juntas conferem proteção em cenários extremos, como altas temperaturas, e em situações como poeira intensa e mergulhos acidentais.
Sua bateria de 5.200 mAh suporta carregamento ultrarrápido de 68 W via USB-C e permite ao gadget receber uma carga para um dia inteiro de uso em apenas 8 minutos, segundo a fabricante. Assim, o usuário não precisa se preocupar em ficar sem energia durante o corre-corre diário.
O Edge 60 de 512 GB (R$ 1.895 no Pix com cupom MELHORDEHJ) será atualizado apenas até o Android 18 e conversa com redes 5G, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4 e NFC.
